    (hK : 2 * K x < p) (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x))
    (hq : IsCenteredLift p q) :
    Φ.hat x q = ∑ y, if h : y ≤ x then
      ∑ z ∈ latticeBox (Φ.flag.rank y) ((p - 1) / 2),
        if (Φ.flag.transition h).integer z = q then Φ.localLift y z else 0
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_eq_localIntegerMassBelow_of_centered hp
    Φ.representation Φ.localWeight Φ.local_supported x q hq
    (fun y h z hz ↦ Φ.isCenteredLift_transition_of_localLift_ne_zero K hbounded h hK z hz)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.hat_eq_sum_localLift
statement:
theorem hat_eq_sum_localLift (hp : Odd p)
    (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f) (K : Φ.flag.Node → ℕ)
    (hbounded : Φ.IsKBounded K) (x : Φ.flag.Node)
    (hK : 2 * K x < p) (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) :
    Φ.hat x q = ∑ y, if h : y ≤ x then
      ∑ z ∈ latticeBox (Φ.flag.rank y) ((p - 1) / 2),
        if (Φ.flag.transition h).integer z = q then Φ.localLift y z else 0
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  exact FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_eq_localIntegerMassBelow hp
    Φ.representation Φ.localWeight Φ.local_supported x q
    (fun y h z hz ↦ Φ.isCenteredLift_transition_of_localLift_ne_zero K hbounded h hK z hz)

name: EGZ.natMass_mono
statement: theorem natMass_mono {w w' : α → ℕ} (h : w' ≤ w) : natMass w' ≤ natMass w
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ ↦ h a

name: EGZ.natMassOn_mono_weight
statement:
theorem natMassOn_mono_weight {w w' : α → ℕ} (h : w' ≤ w) (S : Set α) :
    natMassOn w' S ≤ natMassOn w S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp [ha, h a]

name: EGZ.natMassOn_le
statement: theorem natMassOn_le (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) : natMassOn w S ≤ natMass w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: EGZ.natMassOn_add_compl
statement:
theorem natMassOn_add_compl (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) :
    natMassOn w S + natMassOn w Sᶜ = natMass w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [natMassOn, natMassOn, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp [ha]

name: EGZ.natMass_sub
statement:
theorem natMass_sub {w w' : α → ℕ} (h : w' ≤ w) :
    natMass (fun a ↦ w a - w' a) = natMass w - natMass w'
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_tsub_distrib _ (fun a _ ↦ h a)

name: EGZ.natMassOn_sub
statement:
theorem natMassOn_sub {w w' : α → ℕ} (h : w' ≤ w) (S : Set α) :
    natMassOn (fun a ↦ w a - w' a) S = natMassOn w S - natMassOn w' S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold natMassOn
  rw [← Finset.sum_tsub_distrib]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp [ha]
  · intro a _
    by_cases ha : a ∈ S <;> simp [ha, h a]

name: EGZ.natMassOn_loss_le
statement:
theorem natMassOn_loss_le {w w' : α → ℕ} (h : w' ≤ w) (S : Set α) :
    natMassOn w S - natMassOn w' S ≤ natMass w - natMass w'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natMassOn_sub h, ← natMass_sub h]
  exact natMassOn_le _ _

name: EGZ.natMassOn_loss_le_real
statement:
theorem natMassOn_loss_le_real {w w' : α → ℕ} (h : w' ≤ w) (S : Set α) :
    (natMassOn w S : ℝ) - natMassOn w' S ≤ (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass w'
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ((natMassOn w S - natMassOn w' S : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      ((natMass w - natMass w' : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast natMassOn_loss_le h S
  simpa only [Nat.cast_sub (natMassOn_mono_weight h S),
    Nat.cast_sub (natMass_mono h)] using h'

name: EGZ.nnrealMass_natCast
statement:
theorem nnrealMass_natCast (w : α → ℕ) :
    nnrealMass (fun a ↦ (w a : NNReal)) = (natMass w : NNReal)
proof:
:= by
  simp [nnrealMass, natMass]

name: EGZ.nnrealMassOn_natCast
statement:
theorem nnrealMassOn_natCast (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) :
    nnrealMassOn (fun a ↦ (w a : NNReal)) S = (natMassOn w S : NNReal)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [nnrealMassOn, natMassOn, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_zero]

name: EGZ.isThinAlong_iff_natMass
statement:
theorem isThinAlong_iff_natMass {p d : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    (w : FpCoord p d → ℕ) (ξ : FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p)
    (K : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) :
    IsThinAlong w ξ K ε ↔
      (1 - ε) * (natMass w : ℝ) ≤ (natMassOn w (slab ξ K) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsThinAlong IsThinAlongNNReal
  rw [nnrealMass_natCast, nnrealMassOn_natCast]
  simp

name: EGZ.isThickAlong_iff_compl
statement:
theorem isThickAlong_iff_compl {p d : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    (w : FpCoord p d → ℕ) (ξ : FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p)
    (K : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) :
    IsThickAlong w ξ K δ ↔
      δ * (natMass w : ℝ) < (natMassOn w (slab ξ K)ᶜ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsThickAlong, isThinAlong_iff_natMass, not_le]
  have h := natMassOn_add_compl w (slab ξ K)
  have hreal : (natMassOn w (slab ξ K) : ℝ) + natMassOn w (slab ξ K)ᶜ =
      natMass w := by exact_mod_cast h
  constructor <;> intro hlt <;> nlinarith

name: EGZ.IsThickAlong.of_pruning
statement:
theorem IsThickAlong.of_pruning {p d : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    {w w' : FpCoord p d → ℕ} {ξ : FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p}
    {K : ℕ} {δ α ε M : ℝ}
    (hthick : IsThickAlong w ξ K δ) (hle : w' ≤ w)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hlarge : ε * M ≤ (natMass w : ℝ))
    (hloss : (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass w' ≤ α * M)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ - α / ε) :
    IsThickAlong w' ξ K (δ - α / ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isThickAlong_iff_compl] at hthick ⊢
  have hset := natMassOn_loss_le_real hle (slab ξ K)ᶜ
  have htotal : (natMass w' : ℝ) ≤ natMass w := by
    exact_mod_cast natMass_mono hle
  have hratio : α * M ≤ (α / ε) * (natMass w : ℝ) := by
    have hcancel : α / ε * ε = α := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hε)
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlarge (div_nonneg hα hε.le)
    nlinarith
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htotal hδ
  nlinarith

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.IsKBounded.liftedSupport_bound
statement:
theorem IsKBounded.liftedSupport_bound {Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f}
    {K : Φ.flag.Node → ℕ} (hΦ : Φ.IsKBounded K) (x : Φ.flag.Node)
    (z : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) (hz : z ∈ Φ.liftedSupport x) :
    latticeSupNorm z ≤ K x
proof:
:= by
  apply hΦ
  rw [Φ.polytope_eq_liftedSupport]
  exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

name: EGZ.exists_uniform_rechart_parameters
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_rechart_parameters (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → ℕ, Monotone A ∧ (∀ K, K ≤ A K) ∧
      ∀ BK : ℕ, ∃ p₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ p₀ ∧
        ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] [Fact p.Prime], p₀ < p →
          ∀ (f : FpCoord p d → ℕ) (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
            (K : Φ.flag.Node → ℕ), Φ.IsKBounded K → (∀ x, K x ≤ BK) →
            ∃ C : ∀ x, IntegerLatticeChart (Φ.liftedSupport x),
              (∀ x, Function.Injective ((FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart Φ C x).modp p)) ∧
              (∀ x q, q ∈ (C x).coordinateSupport → IsCenteredLift p q) ∧
              (∀ x (q : IntCoord (C x).rank),
                latticeSupNorm ((C x).map q) ≤ K x → latticeSupNorm q ≤ A (K x)) ∧
              (∀ x (q : IntCoord (C x).rank),
                q.real ∈ (FlagDecomposition.Rechart.polytope Φ C x).carrier →
                  latticeSupNorm q ≤ A (K x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨A, hAmono, hAge, hA⟩ := exists_uniform_integerLatticeChart_bound d
  refine ⟨A, hAmono, hAge, ?_⟩
  intro BK
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_uniform_integerLatticeChart_mod_injective d BK
  let p₀ := max 2 (max B (2 * A BK))
  refine ⟨p₀, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro p _ _ hpp f Φ K hΦ hBK
  have hBp : B < p := (le_max_right 2 _ |>.trans_lt hpp).trans_le' (le_max_left _ _)
  have hAp : 2 * A BK < p :=
    (le_max_right B _).trans_lt ((le_max_right 2 _).trans_lt hpp)
  have hsupport (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
      ∀ z ∈ Φ.liftedSupport x, latticeSupNorm z ≤ K x := hΦ.liftedSupport_bound x
  choose C hC using fun x ↦ hA (K x) (Φ.flag.rank x)
    (Φ.representation.rank_le x) (Φ.liftedSupport x)
    (Φ.liftedSupport_nonempty x) (hsupport x)
  refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, hC, FlagDecomposition.Rechart.polytope_bound Φ C hΦ hC⟩
  · intro x u v huv
    have hcongr :
        ((C x).map (FpCoord.centeredLift u)).mod p =
          ((C x).map (FpCoord.centeredLift v)).mod p := by
      change ((FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart Φ C x).integer (FpCoord.centeredLift u)).mod p =
        ((FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart Φ C x).integer (FpCoord.centeredLift v)).mod p
      rw [← (FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart Φ C x).mod_integer,
        ← (FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart Φ C x).mod_integer,
        FpCoord.mod_centeredLift, FpCoord.mod_centeredLift]
      exact huv
    have hresult := hB (Fact.out : p.Prime) hBp (Φ.flag.rank x)
      (Φ.representation.rank_le x) (Φ.liftedSupport x)
      (fun z hz ↦ (hsupport x z hz).trans (hBK x)) (C x) _ _ hcongr
    simpa only [FpCoord.mod_centeredLift] using hresult
  · intro x q hq
    have hnorm := (C x).coordinateSupport_bound (hsupport x) (hC x) q hq
    have hnorm' : latticeSupNorm q ≤ A BK := hnorm.trans (hAmono (hBK x))
    change latticeSupNorm q ≤ (p - 1) / 2
    omega

name: EGZ.exists_gap_pruning
statement:
theorem exists_gap_pruning {α β : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (s : Finset β) (fibre : β → Set α) (threshold : β → ℝ)
    (hnonneg : ∀ b ∈ s, 0 ≤ threshold b) (w : α → ℕ) :
    ∃ w' : α → ℕ,
      (∀ a, w' a = 0 ∨ w' a = w a) ∧ w' ≤ w ∧
      (∀ b ∈ s, natMassOn w' (fibre b) = 0 ∨
        threshold b < (natMassOn w' (fibre b) : ℝ)) ∧
      (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass w' ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, threshold b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.strongInductionOn generalizing w
  case _ s ih =>
    by_cases hgood : ∀ b ∈ s, natMassOn w (fibre b) = 0 ∨
        threshold b < (natMassOn w (fibre b) : ℝ)
    · refine ⟨w, fun _ ↦ Or.inr rfl, le_rfl, hgood, ?_⟩
      simpa using Finset.sum_nonneg hnonneg
    · push Not at hgood
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hpos, hsmall⟩ := hgood
      let u : α → ℕ := fun a ↦ if a ∈ fibre b then 0 else w a
      have hu : u ≤ w := by
        intro a
        dsimp [u]
        split_ifs <;> omega
      have huclear : natMassOn u (fibre b) = 0 := by
        unfold natMassOn
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro a _
        by_cases ha : a ∈ fibre b <;> simp [u, ha]
      have humass : natMass u = natMassOn w (fibre b)ᶜ := by
        unfold natMass natMassOn
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        by_cases ha : a ∈ fibre b <;> simp [u, ha]
      have hloss : (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass u = natMassOn w (fibre b) := by
        have hm := natMassOn_add_compl w (fibre b)
        rw [← humass] at hm
        have hm' : (natMassOn w (fibre b) : ℝ) + natMass u = natMass w := by
          exact_mod_cast hm
        linarith
      obtain ⟨w', hatoms, hle, hgap, hbound⟩ :=
        ih (s.erase b) (Finset.erase_ssubset hb)
          (fun c hc ↦ hnonneg c (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hc)) u
      refine ⟨w', ?_, hle.trans hu, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a
        rcases hatoms a with ha | ha
        · exact Or.inl ha
        · by_cases hmem : a ∈ fibre b
          · exact Or.inl (ha.trans (by simp [u, hmem]))
          · exact Or.inr (ha.trans (by simp [u, hmem]))
      · intro c hc
        by_cases hcb : c = b
        · subst c
          exact Or.inl (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
            ((natMassOn_mono_weight hle (fibre b)).trans_eq huclear))
        · exact hgap c (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hcb, hc⟩)
      · have hsum : (∑ c ∈ s.erase b, threshold c) + threshold b =
            ∑ c ∈ s, threshold c := Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ hb
        linarith

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.cumulativeWeight_mono
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro y _
  split_ifs
  · exact hle y v
  · exact le_rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_mono
statement:
theorem hat_mono (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    {pieces pieces' : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ}
    (hle : ∀ x v, pieces' x v ≤ pieces x v) (x : F.Node)
    (q : IntCoord (F.rank x)) : hat R pieces' x q ≤ hat R pieces x q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold hat
  split_ifs
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro v _
    split_ifs
    · exact cumulativeWeight_mono hle x v
    · exact le_rfl
  · exact le_rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_eq_natMassOn
statement:
theorem hat_eq_natMassOn (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ) (x : F.Node)
    (q : IntCoord (F.rank x)) (hq : IsCenteredLift p q) :
    hat R pieces x q =
      natMassOn (fun a : F.Node × FpCoord p d ↦ pieces a.1 a.2)
        (cumulativeFibre R x q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold hat
  rw [if_pos hq]
  unfold affineFibreMass cumulativeWeight natMassOn
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  by_cases hv : R.map x v = q.mod p
  · simp [cumulativeFibre, hv]
  · simp [cumulativeFibre, hv]

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.natMass_retainedWeight
statement:
theorem natMass_retainedWeight (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ) :
    natMass (retainedWeight pieces) =
      natMass (fun a : F.Node × FpCoord p d ↦ pieces a.1 a.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold natMass retainedWeight
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.gap_pos
statement:
theorem gap_pos (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f) (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    0 < Φ.gap x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmem := Finset.min'_mem ((Φ.liftedSupport x).image (Φ.hat x))
    ((Φ.liftedSupport_nonempty x).image (Φ.hat x))
  obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
  change 0 < ((Φ.liftedSupport x).image (Φ.hat x)).min' _
  rw [← heq]
  exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ((Φ.liftedSupport_spec x q).mp hq)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.gap_le_hat
statement:
theorem gap_le_hat (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f) (x : Φ.flag.Node)
    (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) (hq : Φ.hat x q ≠ 0) :
    Φ.gap x ≤ Φ.hat x q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr
    ⟨q, (Φ.liftedSupport_spec x q).mpr hq, rfl⟩)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.card_liftedSupport_le
statement:
theorem card_liftedSupport_le (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
    {K : Φ.flag.Node → ℕ} (hK : Φ.IsKBounded K) (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (Φ.liftedSupport x).card ≤ (2 * K x + 1) ^ Φ.flag.rank x
proof:
:= by
  apply card_le_of_latticeSupNorm_le
  intro q hq
  apply hK x q
  rw [Φ.polytope_eq_liftedSupport]
  exact _root_.subset_convexHull ℝ _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.card_liftedSupport_le_pow_dim
statement:
theorem card_liftedSupport_le_pow_dim [Fact p.Prime]
    (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
    {K : Φ.flag.Node → ℕ} (hK : Φ.IsKBounded K) (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (Φ.liftedSupport x).card ≤ (2 * K x + 1) ^ d
proof:
:=
  (Φ.card_liftedSupport_le hK x).trans
    (pow_le_pow_right' (by omega) (Φ.representation.rank_le x))

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.exists_gap_pruned_localWeight
statement:
theorem exists_gap_pruned_localWeight (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
    (threshold : Φ.flag.Node → ℝ) (hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ threshold x) :
    ∃ pieces : Φ.flag.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ,
      (∀ x v, pieces x v = 0 ∨ pieces x v = Φ.localWeight x v) ∧
      (∀ x v, pieces x v ≤ Φ.localWeight x v) ∧
      (∀ x q, FlagDecompositionRaw.hat Φ.representation pieces x q = 0 ∨
        threshold x < (FlagDecompositionRaw.hat Φ.representation pieces x q : ℝ)) ∧
      (Φ.retainedMass : ℝ) - natMass (FlagDecompositionRaw.retainedWeight pieces) ≤
        ∑ x, (Φ.liftedSupport x).card * threshold x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := Finset.univ.sigma Φ.liftedSupport
  obtain ⟨w', hatoms, hle, hgap, hloss⟩ := exists_gap_pruning s
    (fun a ↦ FlagDecompositionRaw.cumulativeFibre Φ.representation a.1 a.2)
    (fun a ↦ threshold a.1) (fun a _ ↦ hnonneg a.1)
    (fun a : Φ.flag.Node × FpCoord p d ↦ Φ.localWeight a.1 a.2)
  let pieces := fun x v ↦ w' (x, v)
  have hpieces : ∀ x v, pieces x v ≤ Φ.localWeight x v := fun x v ↦ hle (x, v)
  refine ⟨pieces, fun x v ↦ hatoms (x, v), hpieces, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x q
    by_cases hq : Φ.hat x q = 0
    · exact Or.inl (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
        ((FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_mono Φ.representation hpieces x q).trans_eq hq))
    · have hmem := (Φ.liftedSupport_spec x q).mpr hq
      have hcentered : IsCenteredLift p q := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hq (by simp only [hat, FlagDecompositionRaw.hat, if_neg hc])
      have h := hgap ⟨x, q⟩ (Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ x, hmem⟩)
      simpa only [FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_eq_natMassOn _ _ _ _ hcentered] using h
  · have hsum : (∑ a ∈ s, threshold a.1) =
        ∑ x, (Φ.liftedSupport x).card * threshold x := by
      simp [s, Finset.sum_sigma, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hsum] at hloss
    simpa only [retainedMass, retainedWeight,
      FlagDecompositionRaw.natMass_retainedWeight] using hloss

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.exists_bounded_gap_pruning
statement:
theorem exists_bounded_gap_pruning [Fact p.Prime]
    (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f) {K : Φ.flag.Node → ℕ}
    (hK : Φ.IsKBounded K) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) :
    ∃ pieces : Φ.flag.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ,
      (∀ x v, pieces x v = 0 ∨ pieces x v = Φ.localWeight x v) ∧
      (∀ x v, pieces x v ≤ Φ.localWeight x v) ∧
      (∀ x q, FlagDecompositionRaw.hat Φ.representation pieces x q ≠ 0 →
        α * (Φ.retainedMass : ℝ) /
            ((Fintype.card Φ.flag.Node : ℝ) * (2 * (K x : ℝ) + 1) ^ d) <
          (FlagDecompositionRaw.hat Φ.representation pieces x q : ℝ)) ∧
      (1 - α) * (Φ.retainedMass : ℝ) ≤
        (natMass (FlagDecompositionRaw.retainedWeight pieces) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N : ℝ := Fintype.card Φ.flag.Node
  let M : ℝ := Φ.retainedMass
  let volume : Φ.flag.Node → ℝ := fun x ↦ (2 * (K x : ℝ) + 1) ^ d
  let threshold : Φ.flag.Node → ℝ := fun x ↦ α * M / (N * volume x)
  have hN : 0 < N := by dsimp [N]; exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hvolume : ∀ x, 0 < volume x := by intro x; dsimp [volume]; positivity
  have hthreshold : ∀ x, 0 ≤ threshold x := by
    intro x
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα hM) (mul_pos hN (hvolume x)).le
  obtain ⟨pieces, hatoms, hle, hgap, hloss⟩ :=
    Φ.exists_gap_pruned_localWeight threshold hthreshold
  have hterm (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
      (Φ.liftedSupport x).card * threshold x ≤ α * M / N := by
    have hcard : ((Φ.liftedSupport x).card : ℝ) ≤ volume x := by
      dsimp [volume]
      exact_mod_cast Φ.card_liftedSupport_le_pow_dim hK x
    calc
      (Φ.liftedSupport x).card * threshold x ≤ volume x * threshold x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard (hthreshold x)
      _ = α * M / N := by
        dsimp [threshold]
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hN, ne_of_gt (hvolume x)]
  have hsum : (∑ x, (Φ.liftedSupport x).card * threshold x) ≤ α * M := by
    calc
      (∑ x, (Φ.liftedSupport x).card * threshold x) ≤
          ∑ _x : Φ.flag.Node, α * M / N := Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ ↦ hterm x
      _ = α * M := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
        change N * (α * M / N) = α * M
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hN]
  refine ⟨pieces, hatoms, hle, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x q hq
    exact (hgap x q).resolve_left hq
  · have hb := hloss.trans hsum
    dsimp [M] at hb
    nlinarith

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.LineageMassMaps.stopped_step_of_lt

theorem stopped_step_of_lt (hminimal : ∀ i, (Φ i).IsMinimal) (n K : ℕ)
    (hstop : ∀ i, n ≤ i → Φ (i + 1) = Φ i)
    (D : ∀ i, i < n → LineageStep (Φ i) (Φ (i + 1))) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :

  simp only [stopped, ofSteps, dif_pos hi]

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.LineageMassMaps.stopped_cutoff_of_lt

    (hstop : ∀ i, n ≤ i → Φ (i + 1) = Φ i)
    (D : ∀ i, i < n → LineageStep (Φ i) (Φ (i + 1))) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
    (stopped hminimal n K hstop D).cutoff i = (D i hi).cutoff
proof:
:= by
  simp only [stopped, ofSteps, dif_pos hi]

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.LineageMassMaps.stopped_cutoff_ge
statement:
theorem stopped_cutoff_ge (hminimal : ∀ i, (Φ i).IsMinimal) (n K : ℕ)
    (hstop : ∀ i, n ≤ i → Φ (i + 1) = Φ i)
    (D : ∀ i, i < n → LineageStep (Φ i) (Φ (i + 1))) {L : ℕ}
    (hLK : L ≤ K) (hcut : ∀ i hi, L ≤ (D i hi).cutoff) :
    ∀ i, L ≤ (stopped hminimal n K hstop D).cutoff i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · simpa only [stopped_cutoff_of_lt hminimal n K hstop D i hi] using hcut i hi
  · simpa only [stopped, ofSteps, dif_neg hi, LineageStep.ofEq_cutoff] using hLK

name: EGZ.normalized_complete_refinement_lemma
statement:
theorem normalized_complete_refinement_lemma (d : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ) (hg : Monotone g) :
    ∃ B : ℕ → ℕ, Monotone B ∧ (∀ K, K ≤ B K) ∧
      ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ p₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ p₀ ∧
        ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] [Fact p.Prime], p₀ < p →
          ∀ (f : FpCoord p d → ℕ) (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
            (anchor : Φ.flag.Node) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
            (hsmall : (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ < 1),
            Φ.IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ K) →
            ∃ (hp : Odd p) (t : ℕ → ℕ) (D : CompletePreparation Φ anchor t δ)
              (C : ∀ x, IntegerLatticeChart ((D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).support x))
              (hmod : ∀ x, Function.Injective
                ((IntegralAffineMap.ofIntAffineMap (C x).map).modp p))
              (hcenter : ∀ x q, q ∈ (C x).coordinateSupport → IsCenteredLift p q)
              (b : ℕ),
              let Ψ := D.normalized hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter
              let S := D.normalizedSubdivisionMap hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter
              K ≤ b ∧ b ≤ B K ∧ Monotone t ∧ t 0 = K ∧ g b ≤ t (D.count + 1) ∧
              Ψ.IsMinimal ∧ Ψ.IsReduced ∧ Ψ.IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ b) ∧
              (Φ.retainedMass : ℝ) - Ψ.retainedMass ≤
                (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ * natMass (Φ.cumulativeWeight anchor) ∧
              @Fintype.card Ψ.flag.Node Ψ.flag.nodeFintype ≤
                2 * Fintype.card Φ.flag.Node ∧
              Ψ.IsCompleteElement (D.normalizedCompleteNode hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter) (g b) δ ∧
              Ψ.cumulativeWeight (D.normalizedCompleteNode hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter) =
                restrictWeight (Φ.cumulativeWeight anchor) D.selectedSet ∧
              (∀ x : Ψ.flag.Node, x.val ≠ D.upperAnchor hp hδ hsmall) ∧
              (∀ (x : Ψ.flag.Node) (Γ : (Φ.flag.polytope (S.node x)).Face)
                (hne : ((Ψ.flag.polytope x).carrier ∩ S.fibre x ⁻¹' Γ.carrier).Nonempty),
                Φ.IsRealizedFace (S.node x) Γ → Ψ.IsRealizedFace x (S.face x Γ hne))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hBmono, hBge, hB⟩ := complete_refinement_lemma d g hg
  refine ⟨B, hBmono, hBge, ?_⟩
  intro K
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hparams⟩ := hB K
  refine ⟨p₀, hp₀, ?_⟩
  intro p _ _ hpp f Φ anchor δ hδ hsmall hΦ
  obtain ⟨hp, t, D, C, hmod, hcenter, b, hKb, hbB, ht, ht0, hgb, _hmin, hbound, _hrest⟩ :=
    hparams p hpp f Φ anchor δ hδ hsmall hΦ
  exact ⟨hp, t, D, C, hmod, hcenter, b, hKb, hbB, ht, ht0, hgb,
    D.normalized_isMinimal hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.normalized_isReduced hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.normalized_isKBounded hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter hbound,
    D.normalized_retainedMass_loss_le hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.normalized_card_le hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    (D.normalizedCompleteNode_isCompleteElement hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter).mono_width hgb,
    D.normalizedCompleteNode_cumulativeWeight hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.normalized_node_ne_upperAnchor hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.normalized_isRealizedFace hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter⟩

name: EGZ.exists_uniform_completePreparation_charts
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_completePreparation_charts (d : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → ℕ, Monotone A ∧ (∀ K, K ≤ A K) ∧
      ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ p₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ p₀ ∧
        ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] [Fact p.Prime], p₀ < p →
          ∃ hp : Odd p,
            ∀ (f : FpCoord p d → ℕ) (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
              (anchor : Φ.flag.Node) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
              (hsmall : (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ < 1)
              (D : CompletePreparation Φ anchor (refinementWidth A g K) δ),
              Φ.IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ K) →
              (∀ i : Fin D.count, 2 * refinementWidth A g K (i + 1) < p) ∧
              ∃ C : ∀ x, IntegerLatticeChart ((D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).support x),
                (∀ x, Function.Injective (((D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).chart C x).modp p)) ∧
                (∀ x q, q ∈ (C x).coordinateSupport → IsCenteredLift p q) ∧
                (∀ x (q : IntCoord (C x).rank),
                  q.real ∈ (((D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).chartedFlag C).polytope x).carrier →
                    latticeSupNorm q ≤ A (refinementWidth A g K D.count))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hAmono, hAge, hA⟩ := exists_uniform_supportChart_parameters (2 * d)
  refine ⟨A, hAmono, hAge, ?_⟩
  intro K
  obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hparams⟩ := hA (refinementWidth A g K d)
  refine ⟨max q₀ (2 * refinementWidth A g K d), hq₀.trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro p _ _ hpp
  have hq : q₀ < p := (le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hpp
  have hwidth : 2 * refinementWidth A g K d < p := (le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hpp
  have hp : Odd p := (Fact.out : p.Prime).odd_of_ne_two (by omega)
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  intro f Φ anchor δ hδ hsmall D hΦ
  have htsmall : ∀ i : Fin D.count, 2 * refinementWidth A g K (i + 1) < p := by
    intro i
    have hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ d := by have := D.count_le; omega
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (refinementWidth_mono A g K hi)).trans_lt hwidth
  refine ⟨htsmall, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hmod, hcenter, _hbox, hpoly⟩ :=
    hparams p hq (D.diagram hp hδ hsmall) (fun _ ↦ refinementWidth A g K D.count)
      (D.diagram_rank_le hp hδ hsmall)
      (D.diagram_support_bound hp hδ hsmall hΦ (refinementWidth_mono A g K)
        (le_refinementWidth A g K D.count) htsmall)
      (fun _ ↦ refinementWidth_mono A g K D.count_le)
  exact ⟨C, hmod, hcenter, hpoly⟩

name: EGZ.complete_refinement_lemma
statement:
theorem complete_refinement_lemma (d : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ) (hg : Monotone g) :
    ∃ B : ℕ → ℕ, Monotone B ∧ (∀ K, K ≤ B K) ∧
      ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ p₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ p₀ ∧
        ∀ (p : ℕ) [NeZero p] [Fact p.Prime], p₀ < p →
          ∀ (f : FpCoord p d → ℕ) (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
            (anchor : Φ.flag.Node) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
            (hsmall : (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ < 1),
            Φ.IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ K) →
            ∃ (hp : Odd p) (t : ℕ → ℕ) (D : CompletePreparation Φ anchor t δ)
              (C : ∀ x, IntegerLatticeChart ((D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).support x))
              (hmod : ∀ x, Function.Injective
                ((IntegralAffineMap.ofIntAffineMap (C x).map).modp p))
              (hcenter : ∀ x q, q ∈ (C x).coordinateSupport → IsCenteredLift p q)
              (b : ℕ),
              let Ψ := D.refined hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter
              let S := D.refinedSubdivisionMap hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter
              K ≤ b ∧ b ≤ B K ∧ Monotone t ∧ t 0 = K ∧
              g b ≤ t (D.count + 1) ∧
              Ψ.IsMinimal ∧ Ψ.IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ b) ∧
              Antitone (fun _ : Ψ.flag.Node ↦ b) ∧
              (Φ.retainedMass : ℝ) - Ψ.retainedMass ≤
                (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ * natMass (Φ.cumulativeWeight anchor) ∧
              @Fintype.card Ψ.flag.Node Ψ.flag.nodeFintype ≤
                2 * Fintype.card Φ.flag.Node ∧
              Ψ.IsCompleteElement (D.lowerAnchor hp hδ hsmall) (g b) δ ∧
              D.completeNode hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter ≤ D.lowerAnchor hp hδ hsmall ∧
              Ψ.IsReducedElement (D.completeNode hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter) ∧
              Ψ.IsCompleteElement (D.completeNode hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter) (g b) δ ∧
              Ψ.cumulativeWeight (D.completeNode hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter) =
                Ψ.cumulativeWeight (D.lowerAnchor hp hδ hsmall) ∧
              ¬ Ψ.IsReducedElement (D.upperAnchor hp hδ hsmall) ∧
              S.node (D.lowerAnchor hp hδ hsmall) = anchor ∧
              S.node (D.upperAnchor hp hδ hsmall) = anchor ∧
              (∀ (x : Ψ.flag.Node) (Γ : (Φ.flag.polytope (S.node x)).Face)
                (hne : ((Ψ.flag.polytope x).carrier ∩ S.fibre x ⁻¹' Γ.carrier).Nonempty),
                Φ.IsRealizedFace (S.node x) Γ → Ψ.IsRealizedFace x (S.face x Γ hne))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hAmono, hAge, hA⟩ := exists_uniform_completePreparation_charts d g
  let B : ℕ → ℕ := fun K ↦ A (refinementWidth A g K d)
  have hBmono : Monotone B := hAmono.comp (refinementWidth_mono_initial hAmono hg d)
  have hBge : ∀ K, K ≤ B K := fun K ↦
    (le_refinementWidth A g K d).trans (hAge _)
  refine ⟨B, hBmono, hBge, ?_⟩
  intro K
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hparams⟩ := hA K
  refine ⟨p₀, hp₀, ?_⟩
  intro p _ _ hpp f Φ anchor δ hδ hsmall hΦ
  obtain ⟨hp, hcharts⟩ := hparams p hpp
  let t := refinementWidth A g K
  let D : CompletePreparation Φ anchor t δ :=
    Classical.choice (nonempty_completePreparation Φ anchor t δ)
  obtain ⟨_htsmall, C, hmod, hcenter, hpoly⟩ := hcharts f Φ anchor δ hδ hsmall D hΦ
  let b := A (t D.count)
  have hgb : g b ≤ t (D.count + 1) := desired_width_le_refinementWidth_succ A g K D.count
  refine ⟨hp, t, D, C, hmod, hcenter, b,
    (le_refinementWidth A g K D.count).trans (hAge _),
    hAmono (refinementWidth_mono A g K D.count_le),
    refinementWidth_mono A g K, rfl, hgb,
    D.refined_isMinimal hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.refined_isKBounded hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter hpoly,
    fun _ _ _ ↦ le_rfl,
    D.refined_retainedMass_loss_le hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.refined_card_le hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    (D.refined_lowerAnchor_isCompleteElement hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter).mono_width hgb,
    D.completeNode_le_lowerAnchor hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    D.completeNode_isReduced hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    (D.completeNode_isCompleteElement hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter).mono_width hgb,
    (D.completeNode_cumulativeWeight hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter).trans
      (D.lowerAnchor_cumulativeWeight hp hδ hsmall).symm,
    D.refined_upperAnchor_not_isReducedElement hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter,
    rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact (D.refinedSubdivisionMap hp hδ hsmall C hmod hcenter).isRealizedFace

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.CompletePreparation.extra_le_count
statement:
theorem extra_le_count (x : (D.split hp hδ hsmall).flag.Node) :
    D.extra hp hδ hsmall x ≤ D.count
proof:
:= by
  change (if x.1.1.2 = 0 then D.count else 0) ≤ D.count
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.CompletePreparation.selected_of_extra_pos
statement:
theorem selected_of_extra_pos (x : (D.split hp hδ hsmall).flag.Node)
    (hx : 0 < D.extra hp hδ hsmall x) (v : FpCoord p d)
    (hv : (D.split hp hδ hsmall).cumulativeWeight x v ≠ 0) : v ∈ D.selectedSet
proof:
:= by
  have hlayer : x.1.1.2 = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    change 0 < (if x.1.1.2 = 0 then D.count else 0) at hx
    rw [if_neg h] at hx
    exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ hx
  have hbase : x.1.1.1 ≤ D.prunedAnchor hp hδ hsmall := x.1.2 hlayer
  rw [LowerTransfer.cumulativeWeight_projection] at hv
  rw [LocalizedPruning.cumulativeWeight_below Φ anchor D.selectedSet
    (D.selected_nonzero hp hδ hsmall) hp x.1.1.1 hbase] at hv
  by_contra h
  exact hv (if_neg h)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.CompletePreparation.slabCoordinates_bound
statement:
theorem slabCoordinates_bound (ht : Monotone t)
    (htsmall : ∀ i : Fin D.count, 2 * t (i + 1) < p)
    (x : (D.split hp hδ hsmall).flag.Node) (v : FpCoord p d)
    (hv : (D.split hp hδ hsmall).cumulativeWeight x v ≠ 0) :
    latticeSupNorm (EGZ.slabCoordinates (D.extra hp hδ hsmall x) D.chain.direction v) ≤
      t D.count
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlayer : x.1.1.2 = 0
  · have heq : D.extra hp hδ hsmall x = D.count := by
      change (if x.1.1.2 = 0 then D.count else 0) = D.count
      rw [if_pos hlayer]
    rw [heq]
    by_cases hk : D.count = 0
    · rw [latticeSupNorm_le_iff]
      intro i
      have hi := i.isLt
      omega
    · apply EGZ.slabCoordinates_bound D.chain.direction t ht htsmall
      exact D.selected_of_extra_pos hp hδ hsmall x (by rw [heq]; omega) v hv
  · have heq : D.extra hp hδ hsmall x = 0 := by
      change (if x.1.1.2 = 0 then D.count else 0) = 0
      rw [if_neg hlayer]
    rw [latticeSupNorm_le_iff]
    intro i
    have hi := i.isLt
    omega

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.CompletePreparation.split_isKBounded
statement:
theorem split_isKBounded {K : ℕ} (hK : Φ.IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ K)) :
    (D.split hp hδ hsmall).IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ K)
proof:
:= by
  intro x q hq
  have hold := (D.subdivisionMap hp hδ hsmall).polytope_mem x hq
  exact hK _ q hold

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.CompletePreparation.diagram_rank_le
statement:
theorem diagram_rank_le (x : (D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).Node) :
    (D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).rank x ≤ 2 * d
proof:
:= by
  change (D.split hp hδ hsmall).flag.rank x + D.extra hp hδ hsmall x ≤ 2 * d
  have hr := (D.split hp hδ hsmall).representation.rank_le x
  have he := (D.extra_le_count hp hδ hsmall x).trans D.count_le
  omega

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.CompletePreparation.diagram_support_bound
statement:
theorem diagram_support_bound {K : ℕ} (hK : Φ.IsKBounded (fun _ ↦ K))
    (ht : Monotone t) (hKt : K ≤ t D.count)
    (htsmall : ∀ i : Fin D.count, 2 * t (i + 1) < p)
    (x : (D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).Node)
    (q : IntCoord ((D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).rank x))
    (hq : q ∈ (D.diagram hp hδ hsmall).support x) : latticeSupNorm q ≤ t D.count
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := Augmented.support_bound (D.split hp hδ hsmall) (D.extra hp hδ hsmall)
    D.chain.direction hp (D.split_isKBounded hp hδ hsmall hK)
      (D.slabCoordinates_bound hp hδ hsmall ht htsmall) x q hq
  exact hbound.trans (max_le hKt le_rfl)

name: EGZ.real_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_int_affineSpan
proof:
:= by
  refine affineSpan_induction hq (fun z hz ↦ subset_affineSpan ℝ _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩) ?_
  intro c u v w hu hv hw
  have h := (affineSpan ℝ (IntCoord.real '' S)).smul_vsub_vadd_mem (c : ℝ) hu hv hw
  simpa only [vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add, IntCoord.real_add, IntCoord.real_sub,
    IntCoord.real_zsmul, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul] using h

name: EGZ.IntCoord.affineSpan_real_range
statement:
theorem IntCoord.affineSpan_real_range (n : ℕ) :
    affineSpan ℝ (Set.range (@IntCoord.real n)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := affineSpan ℝ (Set.range (@IntCoord.real n))
  have hzero : (0 : RealCoord n) ∈ A := subset_affineSpan ℝ _ ⟨0, IntCoord.real_zero⟩
  apply (AffineSubspace.direction_eq_top_iff_of_nonempty ⟨0, hzero⟩).mp
  apply top_unique
  rw [← (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)).span_eq]
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hi : (Pi.basisFun ℝ (Fin n)) i ∈ A := by
    apply subset_affineSpan ℝ _
    refine ⟨Pi.single i 1, ?_⟩
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = i <;> simp [Pi.basisFun_apply, IntCoord.real, hj]
  simpa using A.vsub_mem_direction hi hzero

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.AffineIntSpans.affineSpan_real_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (FlagDecomposition.affineIntSpans_iff_affineSpan_eq_top S).mp hS
  have hsub : Set.range (@IntCoord.real n) ⊆
      (affineSpan ℝ (IntCoord.real '' (S : Set (IntCoord n))) : Set (RealCoord n)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact real_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_int_affineSpan (by rw [hi]; trivial)
  apply top_unique
  rw [← IntCoord.affineSpan_real_range n]
  exact affineSpan_le.mpr hsub

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.polytope_affineSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem polytope_affineSpan_eq_top (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f) (hΦ : Φ.IsMinimal)
    (x : Φ.flag.Node) : affineSpan ℝ (Φ.flag.polytope x).carrier = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ.polytope_eq_liftedSupport, affineSpan_convexHull]
  exact (hΦ x).2.affineSpan_real_eq_top

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.polytope_affineSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem polytope_affineSpan_eq_top (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    affineSpan ℝ (polytope Φ C x).carrier = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [polytope_carrier, affineSpan_convexHull]
  exact (C x).coordinateSupport_affineIntSpans.affineSpan_real_eq_top

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.rank_eq_polytope_dimension
statement:
theorem rank_eq_polytope_dimension (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (C x).rank = Module.finrank ℝ (affineSpan ℝ (Φ.flag.polytope x).carrier).direction
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (⊤ : AffineSubspace ℝ (RealCoord (C x).rank)).map (chart Φ C x).real =
      affineSpan ℝ (Φ.flag.polytope x).carrier := by
    rw [← polytope_affineSpan_eq_top Φ C x, AffineSubspace.map_span, chart_image_polytope]
  rw [← hm, AffineSubspace.map_direction, AffineSubspace.direction_top, Submodule.map_top]
  simpa using (LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj
    ((chart Φ C x).real.linear_injective_iff.mpr (chart_real_injective Φ C x))).symm

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.rank_eq_of_isMinimal
statement:
theorem rank_eq_of_isMinimal (hΦ : Φ.IsMinimal) (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (C x).rank = Φ.flag.rank x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_eq_polytope_dimension, Φ.polytope_affineSpan_eq_top hΦ,
    AffineSubspace.direction_top]
  simp

name: EGZ.exists_integerLatticeChart
statement:
theorem exists_integerLatticeChart {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (IntCoord n))
    (hS : S.Nonempty) : Nonempty (IntegerLatticeChart S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := hS
  let A := affineSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n))
  let D := A.direction
  let b := Module.finBasis ℤ D
  let L : IntCoord (Module.finrank ℤ D) →ₗ[ℤ] IntCoord n :=
    D.subtype.comp b.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap
  let f : IntCoord (Module.finrank ℤ D) →ᵃ[ℤ] IntCoord n :=
    (AffineEquiv.vaddConst ℤ o).toAffineMap.comp L.toAffineMap
  have hoA : o ∈ A := subset_affineSpan ℤ _ ho
  have hrank : Module.finrank ℤ D ≤ n := by
    simpa using D.finrank_le
  refine ⟨⟨Module.finrank ℤ D, hrank, f, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact (AffineEquiv.vaddConst ℤ o).injective.comp
      (Subtype.val_injective.comp b.equivFun.symm.injective)
  · ext q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      exact A.vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (b.equivFun.symm z).property hoA
    · intro hq
      let v : D := ⟨q -ᵥ o, A.vsub_mem_direction hq hoA⟩
      refine ⟨b.equivFun v, ?_⟩
      change ((b.equivFun.symm (b.equivFun v) : D) : IntCoord n) + o = q
      rw [b.equivFun.symm_apply_apply]
      exact sub_add_cancel q o

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.range_real_eq
statement:
theorem range_real_eq {n : ℕ} {S : Finset (IntCoord n)}
    (C : IntegerLatticeChart S) :
    Set.range (fun q : IntCoord C.rank ↦ (C.map q).real) =
      affineIntSpan (IntCoord.real '' (S : Set (IntCoord n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIntSpan_eq_affineSpan_int]
  calc
    Set.range (fun q : IntCoord C.rank ↦ (C.map q).real) =
        IntCoord.real '' Set.range C.map :=
      Set.range_comp (@IntCoord.real n) (fun q : IntCoord C.rank ↦ C.map q)
    _ = IntCoord.real '' (affineSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n)) : Set (IntCoord n)) := by
      rw [C.range_eq]
    _ = (affineSpan ℤ (IntCoord.real '' (S : Set (IntCoord n))) : Set (RealCoord n)) :=
      congrArg (fun A : AffineSubspace ℤ (RealCoord n) ↦ (A : Set (RealCoord n)))
        (AffineSubspace.map_span (IntCoord.realLinearMap n).toAffineMap _)

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.linear_range_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.map.map_vectorSpan (s := Set.univ)
  rw [← direction_affineSpan, AffineSubspace.span_univ, AffineSubspace.direction_top,
    Submodule.map_top, Set.image_univ, C.range_eq,
    ← direction_affineSpan, AffineSubspace.affineSpan_coe, direction_affineSpan] at h
  exact h

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.exists_map_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply C.range_eq.symm.subset
  exact subset_affineSpan ℤ _ hz

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.exists_support_bound
statement:
theorem exists_support_bound {n : ℕ} {S : Finset (IntCoord n)}
    (C : IntegerLatticeChart S) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ S, ∃ q : IntCoord C.rank,
      C.map q = z ∧ latticeSupNorm q ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose coord hcoord using fun z : S ↦ C.exists_map_eq z.property
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup (fun z : S ↦ latticeSupNorm (coord z)), ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  exact ⟨coord ⟨z, hz⟩, hcoord ⟨z, hz⟩,
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun z : S ↦ latticeSupNorm (coord z))
      (Finset.mem_univ (⟨z, hz⟩ : S))⟩

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.exists_box_bound
statement:
theorem exists_box_bound {n : ℕ} {S : Finset (IntCoord n)}
    (C : IntegerLatticeChart S) (K : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ q : IntCoord C.rank,
      latticeSupNorm (C.map q) ≤ K → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := (latticeBox n K).preimage C.map C.injective.injOn
  refine ⟨T.sup latticeSupNorm, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  exact Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_preimage.mpr (mem_latticeBox.mpr hq))

name: EGZ.exists_bounded_integerLatticeChart
statement:
theorem exists_bounded_integerLatticeChart (n K : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ S : Finset (IntCoord n), S.Nonempty →
      (∀ z ∈ S, latticeSupNorm z ≤ K) →
      ∃ C : IntegerLatticeChart S, ∀ q : IntCoord C.rank,
        latticeSupNorm (C.map q) ≤ K → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex (S : Finset (IntCoord n)) :
      ∃ B : ℕ, S.Nonempty → ∃ C : IntegerLatticeChart S,
        ∀ q : IntCoord C.rank,
          latticeSupNorm (C.map q) ≤ K → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B := by
    by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨C⟩ := exists_integerLatticeChart S hS
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := C.exists_box_bound K
      exact ⟨B, fun _ ↦ ⟨C, hB⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h ↦ (hS h).elim⟩
  choose bound hbound using hex
  refine ⟨(latticeBox n K).powerset.sup bound, ?_⟩
  intro S hS hSK
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbound S hS
  refine ⟨C, fun q hq ↦ (hC q hq).trans (Finset.le_sup ?_)⟩
  exact Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (fun z hz ↦ mem_latticeBox.mpr (hSK z hz))

name: EGZ.exists_uniform_integerLatticeChart_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_integerLatticeChart_bound (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : ℕ → ℕ, Monotone A ∧ (∀ K, K ≤ A K) ∧
      ∀ K n, n ≤ d → ∀ S : Finset (IntCoord n), S.Nonempty →
        (∀ z ∈ S, latticeSupNorm z ≤ K) →
        ∃ C : IntegerLatticeChart S, ∀ q : IntCoord C.rank,
          latticeSupNorm (C.map q) ≤ K → latticeSupNorm q ≤ A K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose bound hbound using exists_bounded_integerLatticeChart
  let B (K : ℕ) := (Finset.range (d + 1)).sup (fun n ↦ bound n K)
  let A (K : ℕ) := K ⊔ (Finset.range (K + 1)).sup B
  have hBA (K : ℕ) : B K ≤ A K :=
    (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self K))).trans le_sup_right
  refine ⟨A, ?_, fun K ↦ le_sup_left, ?_⟩
  · intro K L hKL
    exact sup_le_sup hKL (Finset.sup_mono (Finset.range_mono (Nat.add_le_add_right hKL 1)))
  · intro K n hn S hS hSK
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbound n K S hS hSK
    refine ⟨C, fun q hq ↦ (hC q hq).trans ?_⟩
    exact (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))).trans (hBA K)

name: EGZ.exists_uniform_bounded_direction_saturation
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_bounded_direction_saturation (d K : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime → B < p →
      ∀ n, n ≤ d → ∀ S : Finset (IntCoord n),
        (∀ z ∈ S, latticeSupNorm z ≤ K) → ∀ {v : IntCoord n},
          (p : ℤ) • v ∈ vectorSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n)) →
          v ∈ vectorSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex (n : ℕ) := Submodule.exists_uniform_prime_saturation_bound
    (Pi.basisFun ℤ (Fin n)) (latticeBox n K).powerset
    (fun S : Finset (IntCoord n) ↦ vectorSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n)))
  choose bound hbound using hex
  refine ⟨(Finset.range (d + 1)).sup bound, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hBp n hn S hS v hv
  apply hbound n hp
    (lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn))) hBp)
    S ?_ hv
  exact Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (fun z hz ↦ mem_latticeBox.mpr (hS z hz))

name: EGZ.exists_uniform_integerLatticeChart_mod_injective
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_integerLatticeChart_mod_injective (d K : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ {p : ℕ}, p.Prime → B < p →
      ∀ n, n ≤ d → ∀ S : Finset (IntCoord n),
        (∀ z ∈ S, latticeSupNorm z ≤ K) →
        ∀ C : IntegerLatticeChart S, ∀ q r : IntCoord C.rank,
          (C.map q).mod p = (C.map r).mod p → q.mod p = r.mod p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_uniform_bounded_direction_saturation d K
  refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hBp n hn S hS C q r hmod
  have hzero : (C.map q - C.map r).mod p = 0 := by
    ext i
    have hi := congrFun hmod i
    simpa [IntCoord.mod, Int.cast_sub, sub_eq_zero] using hi
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := IntCoord.exists_smul_eq_of_mod_eq_zero _ hzero
  have hvspan : v ∈ vectorSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n)) := by
    apply hB hp hBp n hn S hS
    rw [hv, ← C.linear_range_eq]
    exact ⟨q - r, C.map.linearMap_vsub q r⟩
  rw [← C.linear_range_eq] at hvspan
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hvspan
  have hdiff : (p : ℤ) • t = q - r := by
    apply C.map.linear_injective_iff.mpr C.injective
    rw [map_smul, ht, hv]
    exact (C.map.linearMap_vsub q r).symm
  ext i
  have hi := congrFun hdiff i
  have hcast := congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ (z : ZMod p)) hi
  simpa [IntCoord.mod, sub_eq_zero] using hcast.symm

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.affineFibreMass_cumulativeWeight
statement:
theorem affineFibreMass_cumulativeWeight
    (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ) (x : F.Node)
    (c : FpCoord p (F.rank x)) :
    affineFibreMass (cumulativeWeight pieces x) (R.map x) c =
      localFibreMassBelow R pieces x c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold affineFibreMass cumulativeWeight localFibreMassBelow
  calc
    (∑ v, if R.map x v = c then ∑ y, if y ≤ x then pieces y v else 0 else 0) =
        ∑ v, ∑ y,
          if y ≤ x then (if R.map x v = c then pieces y v else 0) else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro v _
      by_cases hv : R.map x v = c <;> simp [hv]
    _ = ∑ y, ∑ v,
          if y ≤ x then (if R.map x v = c then pieces y v else 0) else 0 := by
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ y, if y ≤ x then
          ∑ v, if R.map x v = c then pieces y v else 0 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      by_cases hy : y ≤ x <;> simp [hy]

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.affineFibreMass_eq_sum_transitionFibres
statement:
theorem affineFibreMass_eq_sum_transitionFibres
    (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ)
    {y x : F.Node} (h : y ≤ x)
    (hsupported : ∀ v, pieces y v ≠ 0 → v ∈ R.space y)
    (c : FpCoord p (F.rank x)) :
    affineFibreMass (pieces y) (R.map x) c =
      ∑ a : FpCoord p (F.rank y),
        if (F.transition h).modp p a = c then
          affineFibreMass (pieces y) (R.map y) a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold affineFibreMass
  rw [show
      (∑ a : FpCoord p (F.rank y),
          if (F.transition h).modp p a = c then
            ∑ v, if R.map y v = a then pieces y v else 0 else 0) =
        ∑ v, ∑ a : FpCoord p (F.rank y),
          if (F.transition h).modp p a = c then
            (if R.map y v = a then pieces y v else 0) else 0 by
    calc
      _ = ∑ a : FpCoord p (F.rank y), ∑ v,
          if (F.transition h).modp p a = c then
            (if R.map y v = a then pieces y v else 0) else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro a _
        by_cases ha : (F.transition h).modp p a = c <;> simp [ha]
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  by_cases hv : pieces y v = 0
  · simp [hv]
  · have hcompat := R.compatible h (hsupported v hv)
    rw [hcompat]
    by_cases hc : (F.transition h).modp p (R.map y v) = c
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (R.map y v)]
      · simp [hc]
      · intro a _ ha
        simp [Ne.symm ha]
      · simp
    · rw [if_neg hc]
      symm
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro a _
      by_cases ha : R.map y v = a
      · subst a
        simp [hc]
      · simp [ha]

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.localFibreMassBelow_eq_localTransitionMassBelow
statement:
theorem localFibreMassBelow_eq_localTransitionMassBelow
    (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ)
    (hsupported : ∀ y v, pieces y v ≠ 0 → v ∈ R.space y)
    (x : F.Node) (c : FpCoord p (F.rank x)) :
    localFibreMassBelow R pieces x c =
      localTransitionMassBelow R pieces x c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold localFibreMassBelow localTransitionMassBelow
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  by_cases h : y ≤ x
  · simp only [h, dif_pos, if_pos]
    exact affineFibreMass_eq_sum_transitionFibres R pieces h
      (hsupported y) c
  · simp [h]

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_eq_sum_localFibreMass
statement:
theorem hat_eq_sum_localFibreMass
    (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ) (x : F.Node)
    (q : IntCoord (F.rank x)) :
    hat R pieces x q = localToCumulativeMass R pieces x q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold hat localToCumulativeMass
  split_ifs with hq
  · exact affineFibreMass_cumulativeWeight R pieces x (q.mod p)
  · rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_eq_localTransitionMassBelow_of_centered
statement:
theorem hat_eq_localTransitionMassBelow_of_centered
    (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ)
    (hsupported : ∀ y v, pieces y v ≠ 0 → v ∈ R.space y)
    (x : F.Node) (q : IntCoord (F.rank x))
    (hq : IsCenteredLift p q) :
    hat R pieces x q =
      localTransitionMassBelow R pieces x (q.mod p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hat_eq_sum_localFibreMass]
  unfold localToCumulativeMass
  rw [if_pos hq]
  exact localFibreMassBelow_eq_localTransitionMassBelow R pieces
    hsupported x (q.mod p)

name: EGZ.exists_finsupp_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hz' : z ∈ affineSpan ℤ (id '' (S : Set (IntCoord n))) := by simpa using hz
  obtain ⟨t, w, ht, hw, hzcomb⟩ :=
    eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_image hz'
  let c : IntCoord n →₀ ℤ := Finsupp.onFinset t
    (fun q ↦ if q ∈ t then w q else 0) (by
      intro q hq
      by_contra hqt
      simp [hqt] at hq)
  have hc : c.support ⊆ t := Finsupp.support_onFinset_subset
  have hcoeff (q : IntCoord n) (hq : q ∈ t) : c q = w q := by simp [c, hq]
  have hsum : (∑ q ∈ c.support, c q) = ∑ q ∈ t, w q := by
    calc
      (∑ q ∈ c.support, c q) = ∑ q ∈ t, c q := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset hc
        intro q hqt hq
        exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hq
      _ = ∑ q ∈ t, w q := Finset.sum_congr rfl hcoeff
  refine ⟨c, hc.trans ht, hsum.trans hw, ?_⟩
  calc
    (∑ q ∈ c.support, c q • q) = ∑ q ∈ t, c q • q := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset hc
      intro q hqt hq
      rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hq, zero_smul]
    _ = ∑ q ∈ t, w q • q := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro q hq
      rw [hcoeff q hq]
    _ = z := by
      rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ hw] at hzcomb
      exact hzcomb.symm

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.affineIntSpans_iff_affineSpan_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hS
    apply top_unique
    intro z _
    obtain ⟨c, hcS, hc, hcz⟩ := hS z
    have hmem := affineCombination_mem_affineSpan_image
      (s := c.support) hc (s' := (S : Set (IntCoord n)))
      (by intro q hq hqS; exact (hqS (hcS hq)).elim) (id : IntCoord n → IntCoord n)
    rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ hc] at hmem
    rw [Set.image_id] at hmem
    change (∑ q ∈ c.support, c q • q) ∈ affineSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n)) at hmem
    rwa [hcz] at hmem
  · intro hS z
    apply exists_finsupp_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan
    rw [hS]
    exact AffineSubspace.mem_top ℤ (IntCoord n) z

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.coordinates_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinates_map (q : IntCoord C.rank) : C.coordinates (C.map q) = q
proof:
:=
  Function.leftInverse_invFun C.injective q

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.map_coordinates_of_mem_affineSpan
statement:
theorem map_coordinates_of_mem_affineSpan {z : IntCoord n}
    (hz : z ∈ affineSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n))) : C.map (C.coordinates z) = z
proof:
:=
  Function.invFun_eq (C.range_eq.symm.subset hz)

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.map_coordinates_of_mem
statement:
theorem map_coordinates_of_mem {z : IntCoord n} (hz : z ∈ S) :
    C.map (C.coordinates z) = z
proof:
:=
  C.map_coordinates_of_mem_affineSpan (subset_affineSpan ℤ _ hz)

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.coordinates_mem_coordinateSupport
statement:
theorem coordinates_mem_coordinateSupport {z : IntCoord n} (hz : z ∈ S) :
    C.coordinates z ∈ C.coordinateSupport
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.mem_coordinateSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coordinateSupport {q : IntCoord C.rank} :
    q ∈ C.coordinateSupport ↔ C.map q ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro hq
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    rwa [C.map_coordinates_of_mem hz]
  · intro hq
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨C.map q, hq, C.coordinates_map q⟩

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.image_coordinateSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_coordinateSupport : C.coordinateSupport.image C.map = S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro hz
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    exact C.mem_coordinateSupport.mp hq
  · intro hz
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨C.coordinates z,
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, C.map_coordinates_of_mem hz⟩

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.coordinateSupport_nonempty
statement: theorem coordinateSupport_nonempty (hS : S.Nonempty) : C.coordinateSupport.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  hS.image C.coordinates

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.card_coordinateSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_coordinateSupport : C.coordinateSupport.card = S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    C.coordinateSupport.card = (C.coordinateSupport.image C.map).card :=
      (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ C.injective).symm
    _ = S.card := congrArg Finset.card C.image_coordinateSupport

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.affineSpan_coordinateSupport
statement:
theorem affineSpan_coordinateSupport :
    affineSpan ℤ (C.coordinateSupport : Set (IntCoord C.rank)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (affineSpan ℤ (C.coordinateSupport : Set (IntCoord C.rank))).map C.map =
      affineSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n)) := by
    rw [AffineSubspace.map_span, ← Finset.coe_image, C.image_coordinateSupport]
  apply top_unique
  intro q _
  have hq : C.map q ∈ affineSpan ℤ (S : Set (IntCoord n)) :=
    C.range_eq.subset ⟨q, rfl⟩
  rw [← hmap] at hq
  obtain ⟨r, hr, heq⟩ := hq
  rwa [C.injective heq] at hr

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.coordinateSupport_affineIntSpans
statement:
theorem coordinateSupport_affineIntSpans :
    FlagDecomposition.AffineIntSpans C.coordinateSupport
proof:
:=
  (FlagDecomposition.affineIntSpans_iff_affineSpan_eq_top _).mpr C.affineSpan_coordinateSupport

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.coordinateSupport_bound
statement:
theorem coordinateSupport_bound {K B : ℕ}
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, latticeSupNorm z ≤ K)
    (hC : ∀ q : IntCoord C.rank, latticeSupNorm (C.map q) ≤ K → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B) :
    ∀ q ∈ C.coordinateSupport, latticeSupNorm q ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  exact hC q (hS _ (C.mem_coordinateSupport.mp hq))

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Augmented.representation_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representation_map (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (representation Φ e ξ hp he C hmod).map x = (C x).rechartMap (map Φ e ξ x)
proof: := rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Augmented.representation_space
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representation_space (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (representation Φ e ξ hp he C hmod).space x =
      affineSpan (ZMod p) {v | Φ.cumulativeWeight x v ≠ 0}
proof: := rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Augmented.local_supported
statement:
theorem local_supported (x : Φ.flag.Node) (v : FpCoord p d) (hv : Φ.localWeight x v ≠ 0) :
    v ∈ (representation Φ e ξ hp he C hmod).space x
proof:
:=
  FpRepresentation.local_supported_cumulativeSpace Φ.localWeight x v hv

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.mem_support
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_support (x : Φ.flag.Node) (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) :
    q ∈ D.support x ↔ D.hat x q ≠ 0
proof: := FlagDecompositionRaw.mem_hatSupport _ _ _ _

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.weight_supported
statement:
theorem weight_supported (x : Φ.flag.Node) (v : FpCoord p d)
    (hv : D.weight x v ≠ 0) : v ∈ Φ.representation.space x
proof:
:=
  Φ.local_supported x v (ne_of_gt ((Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hv).trans_le (D.weight_le x v)))

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.cumulative_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem cumulative_ne_zero_iff (x : Φ.flag.Node) (v : FpCoord p d) :
    D.cumulative x v ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ y, y ≤ x ∧ D.weight y v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hv
    by_cases hyx : y ≤ x
    · exact ⟨y, hyx, by simpa only [if_pos hyx] using hy⟩
    · exact (hy (if_neg hyx)).elim
  · rintro ⟨y, hyx, hy⟩
    have hle : D.weight y v ≤ D.cumulative x v := by
      simpa only [cumulative, FlagDecompositionRaw.cumulativeWeight, if_pos hyx] using Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun z ↦ if z ≤ x then D.weight z v else 0)
        (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ y)
    exact ne_of_gt ((Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hy).trans_le hle)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.cumulative_supported
statement:
theorem cumulative_supported (x : Φ.flag.Node) (v : FpCoord p d)
    (hv : D.cumulative x v ≠ 0) : v ∈ Φ.representation.space x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hyx, hy⟩ := (D.cumulative_ne_zero_iff x v).mp hv
  exact Φ.representation.space_mono hyx (D.weight_supported y v hy)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.cumulative_ne_zero_of_le
statement:
theorem cumulative_ne_zero_of_le {y x : Φ.flag.Node} (h : y ≤ x)
    {v : FpCoord p d} (hv : D.cumulative y v ≠ 0) : D.cumulative x v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hzy, hz⟩ := (D.cumulative_ne_zero_iff y v).mp hv
  exact (D.cumulative_ne_zero_iff x v).mpr ⟨z, hzy.trans h, hz⟩

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.hat_le_old
statement:
theorem hat_le_old (x : Φ.flag.Node) (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) :
    D.hat x q ≤ Φ.hat x q
proof: := FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_mono _ D.weight_le _ _

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.localLift_le_old
statement:
theorem localLift_le_old (x : Φ.flag.Node) (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) :
    D.localLift x q ≤ Φ.localLift x q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold localLift FlagDecomposition.localLift FlagDecompositionRaw.localLift
  split_ifs
  · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro v _
    split_ifs
    · exact D.weight_le x v
    · exact le_rfl
  · exact le_rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.mem_old_polytope
statement:
theorem mem_old_polytope {x : Φ.flag.Node} {q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)}
    (hq : D.hat x q ≠ 0) : q.real ∈ (Φ.flag.polytope x).carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ.polytope_eq_liftedSupport]
  exact _root_.subset_convexHull ℝ _ ⟨q, (Φ.liftedSupport_spec x q).mpr
    (ne_of_gt ((Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hq).trans_le (D.hat_le_old x q))), rfl⟩

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.hat_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem hat_ne_zero_iff (x : Φ.flag.Node) (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) :
    D.hat x q ≠ 0 ↔ IsCenteredLift p q ∧
      ∃ v, Φ.representation.map x v = q.mod p ∧ D.cumulative x v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold hat FlagDecompositionRaw.hat
  by_cases hc : IsCenteredLift p q
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    constructor
    · intro hmass
      obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hmass
      by_cases heq : Φ.representation.map x v = q.mod p
      · exact ⟨hc, v, heq, by simpa only [if_pos heq] using hv⟩
      · exact (hv (if_neg heq)).elim
    · rintro ⟨_, v, heq, hv⟩
      have hle : D.cumulative x v ≤
          FlagDecompositionRaw.affineFibreMass (D.cumulative x) (Φ.representation.map x)
            (q.mod p) := by
        simpa only [FlagDecompositionRaw.affineFibreMass, if_pos heq] using Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun w ↦ if Φ.representation.map x w = q.mod p then D.cumulative x w else 0)
          (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ v)
      exact ne_of_gt ((Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hv).trans_le hle)
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    simp only [ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_iff, not_and]
    exact fun h ↦ (hc h).elim

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.support_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem support_nonempty_iff (hp : Odd p) (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (D.support x).Nonempty ↔ ∃ v, D.cumulative x v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨_, v, _, hv⟩ := (D.hat_ne_zero_iff x q).mp ((D.mem_support x q).mp hq)
    exact ⟨v, hv⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    refine ⟨FpCoord.centeredLift (Φ.representation.map x v), ?_⟩
    rw [D.mem_support, D.hat_ne_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨FpCoord.isCenteredLift_centeredLift hp _, v,
      (FpCoord.mod_centeredLift _).symm, hv⟩

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.transition_centered
statement:
theorem transition_centered {y x : Φ.flag.Node} (h : y ≤ x)
    {q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank y)} (hq : D.hat y q ≠ 0) :
    IsCenteredLift p ((Φ.flag.transition h).integer q)
proof:
:= by
  exact Φ.isCenteredLift_transition_of_mem_polytope h q (D.mem_old_polytope hq)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.transition_mem_support
statement:
theorem transition_mem_support {y x : Φ.flag.Node} (h : y ≤ x)
    {q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank y)} (hq : q ∈ D.support y) :
    (Φ.flag.transition h).integer q ∈ D.support x
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.mem_support] at hq ⊢
  obtain ⟨_, v, hmap, hv⟩ := (D.hat_ne_zero_iff y q).mp hq
  refine (D.hat_ne_zero_iff x _).mpr ⟨D.transition_centered h hq, v, ?_,
    D.cumulative_ne_zero_of_le h hv⟩
  rw [Φ.representation.compatible h (D.cumulative_supported y v hv), hmap,
    (Φ.flag.transition h).mod_integer]

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.PrunedWeights.exists_localLift_of_hat_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_localLift_of_hat_ne_zero (hp : Odd p)
    (x : Φ.flag.Node) (q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)) (hq : D.hat x q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (y : Φ.flag.Node) (h : y ≤ x) (z : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank y)),
      D.localLift y z ≠ 0 ∧ (Φ.flag.transition h).integer z = q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq := FlagDecompositionRaw.hat_eq_localIntegerMassBelow hp
    Φ.representation D.weight D.weight_supported x q
    (fun y h z hz ↦ Φ.isCenteredLift_transition_of_localLift h z
      (ne_of_gt ((Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz).trans_le (D.localLift_le_old y z))))
  rw [show D.hat x q = _ from heq] at hq
  obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hq
  by_cases hyx : y ≤ x
  · rw [dif_pos hyx] at hy
    obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hy
    by_cases heq : (Φ.flag.transition hyx).integer z = q
    · exact ⟨y, hyx, z, by simpa only [if_pos heq] using hz, heq⟩
    · exact (hz (if_neg heq)).elim
  · exact (hy (dif_neg hyx)).elim

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredFibreMass_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem centeredFibreMass_ne_zero_iff (w : FpCoord p d → ℕ)
    (φ : FpCoord p d → FpCoord p n) (q : IntCoord n) :
    centeredFibreMass w φ q ≠ 0 ↔ IsCenteredLift p q ∧
      ∃ v, φ v = q.mod p ∧ w v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold centeredFibreMass
  by_cases hc : IsCenteredLift p q
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    constructor
    · intro hmass
      obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hmass
      by_cases heq : φ v = q.mod p
      · exact ⟨hc, v, heq, by simpa only [if_pos heq] using hv⟩
      · exact (hv (if_neg heq)).elim
    · rintro ⟨_, v, heq, hv⟩
      have hle : w v ≤ affineFibreMass w φ (q.mod p) := by
        simpa only [affineFibreMass, if_pos heq] using Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun u ↦ if φ u = q.mod p then w u else 0)
          (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ v)
      exact ne_of_gt ((Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hv).trans_le hle)
  · rw [if_neg hc]
    simp only [ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_iff, not_and]
    exact fun h ↦ (hc h).elim

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredLift_mem_of_support_spec
statement:
theorem centeredLift_mem_of_support_spec (hp : Odd p)
    (w : FpCoord p d → ℕ) (φ : FpCoord p d → FpCoord p n)
    (S : Finset (IntCoord n))
    (hS : ∀ q, q ∈ S ↔ centeredFibreMass w φ q ≠ 0)
    {v : FpCoord p d} (hv : w v ≠ 0) : FpCoord.centeredLift (φ v) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  apply (hS _).mpr
  exact (centeredFibreMass_ne_zero_iff w φ _).mpr
    ⟨FpCoord.isCenteredLift_centeredLift hp _, v, (FpCoord.mod_centeredLift _).symm, hv⟩

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.rechartMap_eq_coordinates_mod_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hchart : (IntegralAffineMap.ofIntAffineMap C.map).modp p
      ((C.coordinates (FpCoord.centeredLift (φ v))).mod p) = φ v := by
    rw [IntegralAffineMap.mod_integer]
    exact (congrArg (IntCoord.mod p) (C.map_coordinates_of_mem hv)).trans
      (FpCoord.mod_centeredLift _)
  change affineLeftInverse ((IntegralAffineMap.ofIntAffineMap C.map).modp p) (φ v) = _
  conv_lhs => rw [← hchart]
  exact affineLeftInverse_apply _ hmod _

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.rechart_centered_fibre_iff
statement:
theorem rechart_centered_fibre_iff (hp : Odd p)
    (hcenter : ∀ q ∈ C.coordinateSupport, IsCenteredLift p q)
    {v : FpCoord p d} (hv : FpCoord.centeredLift (φ v) ∈ S) (q : IntCoord C.rank) :
    (IsCenteredLift p q ∧ C.rechartMap φ v = q.mod p) ↔
      (IsCenteredLift p (C.map q) ∧ φ v = (C.map q).mod p)
proof:
:= by
  let z := FpCoord.centeredLift (φ v)
  have hzc : IsCenteredLift p z := FpCoord.isCenteredLift_centeredLift hp _
  have hc : IsCenteredLift p (C.coordinates z) :=
    hcenter _ (C.coordinates_mem_coordinateSupport hv)
  have hmap : C.map (C.coordinates z) = z := C.map_coordinates_of_mem hv
  have hnew : C.rechartMap φ v = (C.coordinates z).mod p :=
    C.rechartMap_eq_coordinates_mod_of_mem φ hmod hv
  have hzmod : z.mod p = φ v := FpCoord.mod_centeredLift _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hq, hqmod⟩
    have heq : q = C.coordinates z := hq.eq_of_mod_eq hc (hqmod.symm.trans hnew)
    rw [heq, hmap]
    exact ⟨hzc, hzmod.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hq, hqmod⟩
    have heq : C.map q = z := hq.eq_of_mod_eq hzc (hqmod.symm.trans hzmod.symm)
    have hqcoord : q = C.coordinates z := C.injective (heq.trans hmap.symm)
    rw [hqcoord]
    exact ⟨hc, hnew⟩

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.centeredFibreMass_rechart
statement:
theorem centeredFibreMass_rechart (hp : Odd p)
    (hcenter : ∀ q ∈ C.coordinateSupport, IsCenteredLift p q)
    (w : FpCoord p d → ℕ)
    (hwS : ∀ v, w v ≠ 0 → FpCoord.centeredLift (φ v) ∈ S) (q : IntCoord C.rank) :
    FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredFibreMass w (C.rechartMap φ) q =
      FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredFibreMass w φ (C.map q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredFibreMass_eq_sum,
    FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredFibreMass_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  by_cases hv : w v = 0
  · simp [hv]
  · have heq := C.rechart_centered_fibre_iff φ hmod hp hcenter (hwS v hv) q
    simp only [heq]

name: EGZ.IntegerLatticeChart.coordinateSupport_spec_rechart
statement:
theorem coordinateSupport_spec_rechart (hp : Odd p)
    (hcenter : ∀ q ∈ C.coordinateSupport, IsCenteredLift p q)
    (w : FpCoord p d → ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ z, z ∈ S ↔ FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredFibreMass w φ z ≠ 0)
    (q : IntCoord C.rank) :
    q ∈ C.coordinateSupport ↔
      FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredFibreMass w (C.rechartMap φ) q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.centeredFibreMass_rechart φ hmod hp hcenter w
    (fun _ hv ↦ FlagDecompositionRaw.centeredLift_mem_of_support_spec hp w φ S hS hv),
    C.mem_coordinateSupport]
  exact hS (C.map q)

name: EGZ.flag_decomposition_lemma_posdim
statement:
theorem flag_decomposition_lemma_posdim {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hεhalf : ε ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∃ (δ : ℝ) (Bcard : ℕ), 0 < δ ∧
      ∀ g : ℕ → ℕ, IsGrowing g →
        ∃ (p₀ BK : ℕ), 2 ≤ p₀ ∧ 1 ≤ BK ∧
          ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime), p₀ < p →
            ∀ f : FpCoord p d → ℕ, f ≠ 0 →
              HasFlagDecompositionConclusion hp f ε δ g Bcard BK
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨finalScale d ε, 2 ^ stoppingBound d ε, finalScale_pos d hε, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  let P := normalizedOperationParameters d g hg.1
  refine ⟨P.primeHorizon 1 (stoppingBound d ε), P.radiusHorizon 1 (stoppingBound d ε),
    P.primeThreshold_ge_two _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact P.radiusHorizon_monotone 1 (Nat.zero_le (stoppingBound d ε))
  · intro p hp hprime f hf
    let : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
    let : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    have hpodd : Odd p := hp.odd_of_ne_two (by
      have htwo := P.primeThreshold_ge_two (P.radiusHorizon 1 (stoppingBound d ε))
      change P.primeThreshold (P.radiusHorizon 1 (stoppingBound d ε)) < p at hprime
      omega)
    apply boundedRun.hasConclusion_of_capacity P hd hε hεhalf hg.1 hf hprime hp
    intro Q
    apply FlagDecomposition.Iteration.hasIntervalCapacity Q hpodd hε hεhalf
      (stageScale_antitone hd hε) (fun i ↦ (stageScale_pos d hε i).le)
    · intro i _
      exact (boundedRun P hd hε hεhalf hg.1 hf (stoppingBound d ε) hprime i).card_bound
    · intro i j hij _
      simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hij] using
        boundedRun.mass_loss_tail_relative P hd hε hεhalf hg.1 hf (stoppingBound d ε) hprime i (j - i)

name: EGZ.affineLeftInverse_apply
proof:
:= by
  change A.linear.leftInverse (A q - A 0) = q
  have hlin : A q - A 0 = A.linear q := by
    simpa using (A.linearMap_vsub q 0).symm
  rw [hlin]
  exact LinearMap.leftInverse_apply_of_inj (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr
    (A.linear_injective_iff.mpr hA)) q

name: EGZ.affineLeftInverse_retract
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hq
  rw [affineLeftInverse_apply A hA]

name: EGZ.affineLeftInverse_retract_affineSpan
proof:
:=
  AffineMap.eqOn_affineSpan
    (f := A.comp ((affineLeftInverse A).comp φ)) (g := φ)
    (fun v hv ↦ affineLeftInverse_retract A hA (hS v hv)) hv

name: EGZ.surjOn_affineSpan_of_image_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem surjOn_affineSpan_of_image_span_eq_top {k : Type*} [Field k] {m n : ℕ}
    (φ : (Fin m → k) →ᵃ[k] (Fin n → k)) (S : Set (Fin m → k))
    (hS : affineSpan k (φ '' S) = ⊤) :
    Set.SurjOn φ (affineSpan k S : Set (Fin m → k)) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro q _
  have hq : q ∈ affineSpan k (φ '' S) := by rw [hS]; trivial
  rw [← AffineSubspace.map_span] at hq
  exact hq

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.AffineIntSpans.affineSpan_mod_eq_top
statement:
theorem FlagDecomposition.AffineIntSpans.affineSpan_mod_eq_top {p n : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    [Fact p.Prime]
    {S : Finset (IntCoord n)} (hS : FlagDecomposition.AffineIntSpans S) :
    affineSpan (ZMod p) (IntCoord.mod p '' (S : Set (IntCoord n))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply top_unique
  intro a _
  obtain ⟨c, hcS, hsum, hcoord⟩ := hS (FpCoord.centeredLift a)
  have hsum' : (∑ z ∈ c.support, (c z : ZMod p)) = 1 := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ (z : ZMod p)) hsum
    simpa only [Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_one] using hc
  have hcomb := affineCombination_mem_affineSpan_image
    (s := c.support) (s' := (S : Set (IntCoord n))) hsum'
    (fun _ hz hn ↦ (hn (hcS hz)).elim) (IntCoord.mod p)
  rw [Finset.affineCombination_eq_linear_combination _ _ _ hsum'] at hcomb
  have heq : (∑ z ∈ c.support, (c z : ZMod p) • z.mod p) = a := by
    have hmod := congrArg (IntCoord.mod p) hcoord
    rw [FpCoord.mod_centeredLift] at hmod
    convert hmod using 1
    ext i
    simp [IntCoord.mod, Finset.sum_apply, Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_mul]
  rwa [heq] at hcomb

name: EGZ.restrictWeight_le
statement: theorem restrictWeight_le (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) : restrictWeight w S ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro v
  change (if v ∈ S then w v else 0) ≤ w v
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact Nat.zero_le _

name: EGZ.restrictWeight_ne_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictWeight_ne_zero_iff (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) (v : α) :
    restrictWeight w S v ≠ 0 ↔ v ∈ S ∧ w v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v ∈ S <;> simp [restrictWeight, hv]

name: EGZ.natMass_restrictWeight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natMass_restrictWeight (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) :
    natMass (restrictWeight w S) = natMassOn w S
proof: := rfl

name: EGZ.restrictWeight_loss_eq_compl
statement:
theorem restrictWeight_loss_eq_compl (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) :
    (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass (restrictWeight w S) = (natMassOn w Sᶜ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (natMassOn w S : ℝ) + natMassOn w Sᶜ = natMass w := by
    exact_mod_cast natMassOn_add_compl w S
  rw [natMass_restrictWeight]
  linarith

name: EGZ.natMassOn_compl_intersection_le
statement:
theorem natMassOn_compl_intersection_le (w : α → ℕ) (S : I → Set α) :
    natMassOn w {v | ∀ i, v ∈ S i}ᶜ ≤ ∑ i, natMassOn w (S i)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold natMassOn
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro v _
  by_cases hv : ∀ i, v ∈ S i
  · simp [hv]
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp hv
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun i ↦ if v ∈ (S i)ᶜ then w v else 0)
      (fun i _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hv, not_false_eq_true,
      ite_true, hi] using hle

name: EGZ.restrictWeight_intersection_loss_le
statement:
theorem restrictWeight_intersection_loss_le (w : α → ℕ) (S : I → Set α)
    (ε : I → ℝ)
    (hS : ∀ i, (natMassOn w (S i)ᶜ : ℝ) ≤ ε i * natMass w) :
    (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass (restrictWeight w {v | ∀ i, v ∈ S i}) ≤
      (∑ i, ε i) * natMass w
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictWeight_loss_eq_compl]
  calc
    (natMassOn w {v | ∀ i, v ∈ S i}ᶜ : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, (natMassOn w (S i)ᶜ : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast natMassOn_compl_intersection_le w S
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ε i * natMass w := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ hS i)
    _ = (∑ i, ε i) * natMass w := (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm

name: EGZ.restrictWeight_retainedMass_ge
statement:
theorem restrictWeight_retainedMass_ge (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) (ε : ℝ)
    (hloss : (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass (restrictWeight w S) ≤ ε * natMass w) :
    (1 - ε) * (natMass w : ℝ) ≤ natMass (restrictWeight w S)
proof:
:= by
  linarith

name: EGZ.restrictWeight_nonzero_of_loss_lt_one
statement:
theorem restrictWeight_nonzero_of_loss_lt_one (w : α → ℕ) (S : Set α) (ε : ℝ)
    (hw : ∃ v, w v ≠ 0) (hε : ε < 1)
    (hloss : (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass (restrictWeight w S) ≤ ε * natMass w) :
    ∃ v, restrictWeight w S v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hw
  have hmass : 0 < natMass w := (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hv).trans_le
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ v))
  have hmass' : (0 : ℝ) < natMass w := by exact_mod_cast hmass
  have hret := restrictWeight_retainedMass_ge w S ε hloss
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < natMass (restrictWeight w S) :=
    (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hε) hmass').trans_le hret
  have hn : natMass (restrictWeight w S) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hpos
  obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hn
  exact ⟨v, hv⟩

name: EGZ.IsThinAlong.compl_mass_le
statement:
theorem IsThinAlong.compl_mass_le {p d : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    {w : FpCoord p d → ℕ} {ξ : FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p}
    {t : ℕ} {ε : ℝ} (h : IsThinAlong w ξ t ε) :
    (natMassOn w (slab ξ t)ᶜ : ℝ) ≤ ε * natMass w
proof:
:= by
  have hthin := (isThinAlong_iff_natMass w ξ t ε).mp h
  have htotal : (natMassOn w (slab ξ t) : ℝ) + natMassOn w (slab ξ t)ᶜ = natMass w := by
    exact_mod_cast natMassOn_add_compl w (slab ξ t)
  linarith

name: EGZ.sum_three_pow_succ_le
statement:
theorem sum_three_pow_succ_le (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin k, (3 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1)) ≤ 3 ^ (k + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]
    have hpow : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
    rw [show (3 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1 + 1) = 3 ^ (k + 1) * 3 from pow_succ _ _]
    nlinarith

name: EGZ.DirectionChain.slabIntersection_loss_le_sum
statement:
theorem slabIntersection_loss_le_sum :
    (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass (restrictWeight w (slabIntersection k D.direction t)) ≤
      (∑ i : Fin k, (3 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) * δ) * natMass w
proof:
:=
  restrictWeight_intersection_loss_le w (fun i : Fin k ↦ slab (D.direction i) (t (i + 1)))
    (fun i ↦ (3 : ℝ) ^ (i.val + 1) * δ)
    (fun i ↦ (D.selected i i.isLt).compl_mass_le)

name: EGZ.DirectionChain.slabIntersection_loss_le
statement:
theorem slabIntersection_loss_le (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass (restrictWeight w (slabIntersection k D.direction t)) ≤
      ((3 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) - 1) * δ * natMass w
proof:
:= by
  apply D.slabIntersection_loss_le_sum.trans
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (sum_three_pow_succ_le k) hδ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: EGZ.DirectionChain.slabIntersection_loss_le_dimension
statement:
theorem slabIntersection_loss_le_dimension (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hkd : k ≤ d) :
    (natMass w : ℝ) - natMass (restrictWeight w (slabIntersection k D.direction t)) ≤
      (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ * natMass w
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.slabIntersection_loss_le hδ).trans
  have hpow : (3 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) ≤ 3 ^ (d + 1) :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.add_le_add_right hkd 1)
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hδ

name: EGZ.DirectionChain.slabIntersection_retainedMass_ge
statement:
theorem slabIntersection_retainedMass_ge (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hkd : k ≤ d) :
    (1 - (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ) * natMass w ≤
      (natMass (restrictWeight w (slabIntersection k D.direction t)) : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  restrictWeight_retainedMass_ge _ _ _ (D.slabIntersection_loss_le_dimension hδ hkd)

name: EGZ.DirectionChain.slabIntersection_nonzero
statement:
theorem slabIntersection_nonzero (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hkd : k ≤ d)
    (hsmall : (3 : ℝ) ^ (d + 1) * δ < 1) (hw : ∃ v, w v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ v, restrictWeight w (slabIntersection k D.direction t) v ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  restrictWeight_nonzero_of_loss_lt_one _ _ _ hw hsmall
    (D.slabIntersection_loss_le_dimension hδ hkd)

name: EGZ.DirectionChain.thick_slabIntersection
statement:
theorem thick_slabIntersection (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    {ξ : FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p}
    (hthick : IsThickAlong w ξ (t (k + 1)) ((3 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * δ)) :
    IsThickAlong (restrictWeight w (slabIntersection k D.direction t)) ξ (t (k + 1)) δ
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 ^ (k + 1) := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have heq : (3 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * δ - ((3 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) - 1) * δ / 1 = δ := by ring
  have h := hthick.of_pruning (restrictWeight_le _ _) (ε := 1) (M := natMass w)
    (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hpow) hδ) (by simp)
    (D.slabIntersection_loss_le hδ) (by rw [heq]; exact hδ)
  rwa [heq] at h

name: EGZ.DirectionChain.thick_slabIntersection_of_maximal
statement:
theorem thick_slabIntersection_of_maximal (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hmax : ∀ ξ, ξ ∉ D.space k → IsThickAlong w ξ (t (k + 1)) ((3 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * δ))
    (ξ : FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p) (hξ : ξ ∉ D.space k) :
    IsThickAlong (restrictWeight w (slabIntersection k D.direction t)) ξ (t (k + 1)) δ
proof:
:=
  D.thick_slabIntersection hδ (hmax ξ hξ)

name: EGZ.HasBoundedRepresentative.valMinAbs_natAbs_le
statement:
theorem HasBoundedRepresentative.valMinAbs_natAbs_le {p K : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    {a : ZMod p} (ha : HasBoundedRepresentative p K a) (hK : 2 * K < p) :
    a.valMinAbs.natAbs ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hza⟩ := ha
  have hval : a.valMinAbs = z := (ZMod.valMinAbs_spec a z).mpr ⟨hza.symm, by
    constructor <;> omega⟩
  rwa [hval]

name: EGZ.slabCoordinates_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem slabCoordinates_mod {p d k : ℕ}
    (ξ : ℕ → FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p) (v : FpCoord p d) :
    (slabCoordinates k ξ v).mod p = fun i : Fin k ↦ ξ i v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact ZMod.coe_valMinAbs _

name: EGZ.slabCoordinates_apply_bound
statement:
theorem slabCoordinates_apply_bound {p d k : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    (ξ : ℕ → FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p) (t : ℕ → ℕ)
    {v : FpCoord p d} (hv : v ∈ slabIntersection k ξ t)
    (i : Fin k) (hsmall : 2 * t (i + 1) < p) :
    (slabCoordinates k ξ v i).natAbs ≤ t (i + 1)
proof:
:=
  (hv i).valMinAbs_natAbs_le hsmall

name: EGZ.slabCoordinates_bound
statement:
theorem slabCoordinates_bound {p d k : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    (ξ : ℕ → FpCoord p d →ᵃ[ZMod p] ZMod p) (t : ℕ → ℕ)
    (ht : Monotone t) (hsmall : ∀ i : Fin k, 2 * t (i + 1) < p)
    {v : FpCoord p d} (hv : v ∈ slabIntersection k ξ t) :
    latticeSupNorm (slabCoordinates k ξ v) ≤ t k
proof:
:= by
  rw [latticeSupNorm_le_iff]
  intro i
  exact (slabCoordinates_apply_bound ξ t hv i (hsmall i)).trans (ht (by omega))
