name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.CompletePreparation.count_pos_of_not_complete
statement:
theorem count_pos_of_not_complete (T : ℕ) (hwidth : T ≤ t 1)
    (hnot : ¬ Φ.IsCompleteElement anchor T δ) : 0 < D.count
proof:
:= by
  apply D.chain.length_pos_of_exists D.maximal
  simp only [IsCompleteElement, IsThickAlong, not_forall, not_not] at hnot
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hthin⟩ := hnot
  refine ⟨η, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hmem
    exact ((Φ.representation.mem_fiberConstantSubmodule_iff anchor η).mp hmem) hη
  · exact (hthin.mono_width hwidth).mono_error (by norm_num; linarith)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.transition_mem_liftedSupport
statement:
theorem transition_mem_liftedSupport (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
    {x y : Φ.flag.Node} (h : x ≤ y) {q : IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank x)}
    (hq : q ∈ Φ.liftedSupport x) :
    (Φ.flag.transition h).integer q ∈ Φ.liftedSupport y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ.liftedSupport_eq_hatSupport] at hq ⊢
  exact Φ.originalWeights.transition_mem_support h hq

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart_real_injective
statement: theorem chart_real_injective (x : Φ.flag.Node) : Function.Injective (chart Φ C x).real
proof:
:=
  IntegralAffineMap.ofIntAffineMap_real_injective _ (C x).injective

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.polytope_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polytope_carrier (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (polytope Φ C x).carrier =
      convexHull ℝ (IntCoord.real '' ((C x).coordinateSupport : Set (IntCoord (C x).rank)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polytope, RationalPolytope.ofFinsetConvexHull_carrier, Finset.coe_image]

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart_image_polytope
statement:
theorem chart_image_polytope (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    (chart Φ C x).real '' (polytope Φ C x).carrier = (Φ.flag.polytope x).carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [polytope_carrier, AffineMap.image_convexHull, Φ.polytope_eq_liftedSupport]
  congr 1
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(C x).map z, (C x).mem_coordinateSupport.mp hz,
      ((chart Φ C x).real_integer z).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨((C x).coordinates z).real,
      ⟨(C x).coordinates z, (C x).coordinates_mem_coordinateSupport hz, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [(chart Φ C x).real_integer]
    change ((C x).map ((C x).coordinates z)).real = z.real
    rw [(C x).map_coordinates_of_mem hz]

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart_mem_polytope_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chart_mem_polytope_iff (x : Φ.flag.Node) (q : RealCoord (C x).rank) :
    (chart Φ C x).real q ∈ (Φ.flag.polytope x).carrier ↔ q ∈ (polytope Φ C x).carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [← chart_image_polytope Φ C x]
  exact (chart_real_injective Φ C x).mem_set_image

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.polytope_bound
statement:
theorem polytope_bound {K B : Φ.flag.Node → ℕ} (hΦ : Φ.IsKBounded K)
    (hC : ∀ x (q : IntCoord (C x).rank),
      latticeSupNorm ((C x).map q) ≤ K x → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B x) :
    ∀ x (q : IntCoord (C x).rank),
      q.real ∈ (polytope Φ C x).carrier → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B x
proof:
:= by
  intro x q hq
  apply hC
  apply hΦ
  change ((chart Φ C x).integer q).real ∈ (Φ.flag.polytope x).carrier
  rw [← (chart Φ C x).real_integer]
  exact (chart_mem_polytope_iff Φ C x q.real).mpr hq

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.transition_support
statement:
theorem transition_support {x y : Φ.flag.Node} (h : x ≤ y) :
    ∀ z ∈ Φ.liftedSupport x, (Φ.flag.transition h).toIntAffineMap z ∈
      affineSpan ℤ (Φ.liftedSupport y : Set (IntCoord (Φ.flag.rank y)))
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  exact subset_affineSpan ℤ _ (Φ.transition_mem_liftedSupport h hz)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart_comp_transition
statement:
theorem chart_comp_transition {x y : Φ.flag.Node} (h : x ≤ y) :
    (chart Φ C y).comp (transition Φ C h) = (Φ.flag.transition h).comp (chart Φ C x)
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegralAffineMap.ext_integer
  funext q
  exact (C x).map_transition (C y) (Φ.flag.transition h).toIntAffineMap
    (transition_support Φ h) q

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart_transition_real
statement:
theorem chart_transition_real {x y : Φ.flag.Node} (h : x ≤ y)
    (q : RealCoord (C x).rank) :
    (chart Φ C y).real ((transition Φ C h).real q) =
      (Φ.flag.transition h).real ((chart Φ C x).real q)
proof:
:=
  AffineMap.congr_fun (congrArg IntegralAffineMap.real (chart_comp_transition Φ C h)) q

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.chart_transition_modp
statement:
theorem chart_transition_modp {x y : Φ.flag.Node} (h : x ≤ y) (r : ℕ)
    (q : FpCoord r (C x).rank) :
    (chart Φ C y).modp r ((transition Φ C h).modp r q) =
      (Φ.flag.transition h).modp r ((chart Φ C x).modp r q)
proof:
:=
  AffineMap.congr_fun
    (congrArg (fun A ↦ A.modp r) (chart_comp_transition Φ C h)) q

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.transition_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply (chart_mem_polytope_iff Φ C y _).mp
  rw [chart_transition_real]
  exact Φ.flag.transition_mem h ((chart_mem_polytope_iff Φ C x q).mpr hq)

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.transition_refl
statement:
theorem transition_refl (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    transition Φ C (le_refl x) = IntegralAffineMap.id (C x).rank
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegralAffineMap.ext_integer
  funext q
  apply (C x).injective
  change (C x).map ((C x).transition (C x) _ _ q) = (C x).map q
  rw [(C x).map_transition]
  change (Φ.flag.transition (le_refl x)).integer ((C x).map q) = (C x).map q
  rw [Φ.flag.transition_refl]
  rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Rechart.transition_trans
statement:
theorem transition_trans {x y z : Φ.flag.Node} (hxy : x ≤ y) (hyz : y ≤ z) :
    transition Φ C (hxy.trans hyz) = (transition Φ C hyz).comp (transition Φ C hxy)
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegralAffineMap.ext_integer
  funext q
  apply (C z).injective
  change (C z).map ((C x).transition (C z) _ _ q) =
    (C z).map ((C y).transition (C z) _ _ ((C x).transition (C y) _ _ q))
  rw [(C x).map_transition, (C y).map_transition, (C x).map_transition]
  exact congrFun (congrArg IntegralAffineMap.integer (Φ.flag.transition_trans hxy hyz))
    ((C x).map q)

name: EGZ.latticeSupNorm_le_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem latticeSupNorm_le_iff {n K : ℕ} {z : IntCoord n} :
    latticeSupNorm z ≤ K ↔ ∀ i, (z i).natAbs ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  simp [latticeSupNorm, Finset.sup_le_iff]

name: EGZ.isCenteredLift_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isCenteredLift_iff {p n : ℕ} {z : IntCoord n} :
    IsCenteredLift p z ↔ ∀ i, (z i).natAbs ≤ (p - 1) / 2
proof:
:=
  latticeSupNorm_le_iff

name: EGZ.mem_latticeBox
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_latticeBox {n K : ℕ} {z : IntCoord n} :
    z ∈ latticeBox n K ↔ latticeSupNorm z ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  simp only [latticeBox, Fintype.mem_piFinset, Finset.mem_Icc,
    latticeSupNorm_le_iff]
  congr! 1
  omega

name: EGZ.card_latticeBox
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_latticeBox (n K : ℕ) :
    (latticeBox n K).card = (2 * K + 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [latticeBox, Fintype.card_piFinset, Int.card_Icc]
  congr 1
  omega

name: EGZ.card_le_of_latticeSupNorm_le
statement:
theorem card_le_of_latticeSupNorm_le {n K : ℕ} (S : Finset (IntCoord n))
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ S, latticeSupNorm z ≤ K) :
    S.card ≤ (2 * K + 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_latticeBox]
  exact Finset.card_le_card (fun z hz ↦ mem_latticeBox.mpr (hS z hz))

name: EGZ.FpCoord.centeredLift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centeredLift_apply {p n : ℕ} (c : FpCoord p n) (i : Fin n) :
    centeredLift c i = (c i).valMinAbs
proof: := rfl

name: EGZ.FpCoord.mod_centeredLift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mod_centeredLift {p n : ℕ} (c : FpCoord p n) :
    (centeredLift c).mod p = c
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact ZMod.coe_valMinAbs (c i)

name: EGZ.FpCoord.isCenteredLift_centeredLift
statement:
theorem isCenteredLift_centeredLift {p n : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    (hp : Odd p) (c : FpCoord p n) : IsCenteredLift p (centeredLift c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCenteredLift_iff]
  intro i
  have hpdiv : p / 2 = (p - 1) / 2 := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hp
    omega
  simpa only [centeredLift_apply, ← hpdiv] using (c i).natAbs_valMinAbs_le

name: EGZ.FpCoord.centeredLift_mod
statement:
theorem centeredLift_mod {p n : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    {z : IntCoord n} (hz : IsCenteredLift p z) : centeredLift (z.mod p) = z
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  apply (ZMod.valMinAbs_spec _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hi := isCenteredLift_iff.mp hz i
    have hp := NeZero.pos p
    omega
  · have hi := isCenteredLift_iff.mp hz i
    omega

name: EGZ.IsCenteredLift.eq_of_mod_eq
statement:
theorem IsCenteredLift.eq_of_mod_eq {p n : ℕ} [NeZero p]
    {z w : IntCoord n} (hz : IsCenteredLift p z) (hw : IsCenteredLift p w)
    (h : z.mod p = w.mod p) : z = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← FpCoord.centeredLift_mod hz, h, FpCoord.centeredLift_mod hw]

name: EGZ.existsUnique_isCenteredLift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_isCenteredLift {p n : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : Odd p)
    (c : FpCoord p n) : ∃! z : IntCoord n, IsCenteredLift p z ∧ z.mod p = c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨FpCoord.centeredLift c,
    ⟨FpCoord.isCenteredLift_centeredLift hp c, FpCoord.mod_centeredLift c⟩, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  rw [← hz.2, FpCoord.centeredLift_mod hz.1]

name: EGZ.sum_latticeBox_mod
statement:
theorem sum_latticeBox_mod {p n : ℕ} [NeZero p] (hp : Odd p)
    (g : FpCoord p n → ℕ) :
    ∑ z ∈ latticeBox n ((p - 1) / 2), g (z.mod p) = ∑ c, g c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun z _ ↦ z.mod p)
  · intro z hz
    exact Finset.mem_univ _
  · intro z hz w hw hzw
    exact IsCenteredLift.eq_of_mod_eq (mem_latticeBox.mp hz)
      (mem_latticeBox.mp hw) hzw
  · intro c _
    refine ⟨FpCoord.centeredLift c, ?_, FpCoord.mod_centeredLift c⟩
    exact mem_latticeBox.mpr (FpCoord.isCenteredLift_centeredLift hp c)
  · intro z hz
    rfl

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.mem_hatSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_hatSupport (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ) (x : F.Node)
    (z : IntCoord (F.rank x)) :
    z ∈ hatSupport R pieces x ↔ hat R pieces x z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [hatSupport, Finset.mem_filter, mem_latticeBox]
  constructor
  · exact And.right
  · intro hz
    refine ⟨?_, hz⟩
    by_contra hcentered
    exact hz (by simp [hat, IsCenteredLift, hcentered])

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.sum_affineFibreMass
statement:
theorem sum_affineFibreMass {n : ℕ} (w : FpCoord p d → ℕ)
    (φ : FpCoord p d → FpCoord p n) :
    ∑ c, affineFibreMass w φ c = natMass w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold affineFibreMass natMass
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

name: EGZ.FlagDecompositionRaw.sum_hatSupport
statement:
theorem sum_hatSupport (hp : Odd p) (R : FpRepresentation p d F)
    (pieces : F.Node → FpCoord p d → ℕ) (x : F.Node) :
    ∑ z ∈ hatSupport R pieces x, hat R pieces x z =
      natMass (cumulativeWeight pieces x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∑ z ∈ hatSupport R pieces x, hat R pieces x z =
        ∑ z ∈ latticeBox (F.rank x) ((p - 1) / 2), hat R pieces x z := by
          rw [hatSupport, Finset.sum_filter]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro z _
          split_ifs with hz
          · rfl
          · exact (not_ne_iff.mp hz).symm
    _ = ∑ z ∈ latticeBox (F.rank x) ((p - 1) / 2),
        affineFibreMass (cumulativeWeight pieces x) (R.map x) (z.mod p) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro z hz
          exact if_pos (mem_latticeBox.mp hz : IsCenteredLift p z)
    _ = ∑ c, affineFibreMass (cumulativeWeight pieces x) (R.map x) c :=
      sum_latticeBox_mod hp _
    _ = natMass (cumulativeWeight pieces x) := sum_affineFibreMass _ _

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.liftedSupport_eq_hatSupport
statement:
theorem liftedSupport_eq_hatSupport (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
    (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    Φ.liftedSupport x =
      FlagDecompositionRaw.hatSupport Φ.representation Φ.localWeight x
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [Φ.liftedSupport_spec, FlagDecompositionRaw.mem_hatSupport]

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.sum_liftedSupport
statement:
theorem sum_liftedSupport (hp : Odd p) (Φ : FlagDecomposition p d f)
    (x : Φ.flag.Node) :
    ∑ z ∈ Φ.liftedSupport x, Φ.hat x z = natMass (Φ.cumulativeWeight x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ.liftedSupport_eq_hatSupport]
  exact FlagDecompositionRaw.sum_hatSupport hp Φ.representation Φ.localWeight x

name: EGZ.FpRepresentation.rank_le
statement:
theorem rank_le {p d : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : ConvexFlag}
    (R : FpRepresentation p d F) (x : F.Node) : F.rank x ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (R.map x) := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨v, _hv, hvc⟩ := R.map_surjective x (Set.mem_univ c)
    exact ⟨v, hvc⟩
  have hlinear := (R.map x).linear_surjective_iff.mpr hsurj
  simpa using LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective hlinear

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Iteration.progressColor_eq
statement:
theorem progressColor_eq (i : ℕ) (hi : i < N) :
    progressColor P i = (P i hi).event.color
proof: := dif_pos hi

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Iteration.progressColor_lt
statement:
theorem progressColor_lt (i : ℕ) (hi : i < N) :
    progressColor P i < 2 * (d + 1) ^ 2 + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [progressColor_eq P i hi]
  exact (P i hi).event.color_lt

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Iteration.hasIntervalCapacity_of_event_bounds
statement:
theorem hasIntervalCapacity_of_event_bounds
    (hδ : Antitone δ) (hδnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a b L, a ≤ b → b < N → L < (d + 1) ^ 2 →
      (∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc a b, 2 * L ≤ progressColor P i) →
      ((Finset.Icc a b).filter fun i ↦ progressColor P i = 2 * L).card ≤ 2 ^ a)
    (hface : ∀ a b L, a ≤ b → b < N → L < (d + 1) ^ 2 →
      (∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc a b, 2 * L + 1 ≤ progressColor P i) →
      ((Finset.Icc a b).filter fun i ↦ progressColor P i = 2 * L + 1).card ≤
        intervalCapacity d ε a) :
    HasIntervalCapacity (progressColor P) (intervalCapacity d ε) N
proof:
:= by
  intro a b l hab hb hlow
  by_cases hn : ((Finset.Icc a b).filter fun i ↦ progressColor P i = l).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hn
    obtain ⟨hiab, hil⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hi
    have hiN : i < N := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hiab).2.trans_lt hb
    have hl : l < 2 * (d + 1) ^ 2 + 1 := hil ▸ progressColor_lt P i hiN
    by_cases hlgap : l = 2 * (d + 1) ^ 2
    · have hgap : (Finset.Icc a b).card ≤ 1 :=
        card_gap_interval_le_one P hδ hδnonneg hab hb (by
          intro j hj
          rw [← progressColor_eq P j ((Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).2.trans_lt hb), ← hlgap]
          exact hlow j hj)
      exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (hgap.trans (one_le_intervalCapacity d ε a))
    · have hL : l / 2 < (d + 1) ^ 2 := by omega
      have hparity : l = 2 * (l / 2) ∨ l = 2 * (l / 2) + 1 := by omega
      rcases hparity with heven | hodd
      · rw [heven] at hlow ⊢
        exact (hcomplete a b (l / 2) hab hb hL hlow).trans (pow_le_intervalCapacity d ε a)
      · rw [hodd] at hlow ⊢
        exact hface a b (l / 2) hab hb hL hlow
  · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

name: EGZ.FlagDecomposition.Iteration.length_lt_stoppingBound_of_event_bounds
statement:
theorem length_lt_stoppingBound_of_event_bounds
    (hδ : Antitone δ) (hδnonneg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i)
    (hcomplete : ∀ a b L, a ≤ b → b < N → L < (d + 1) ^ 2 →
      (∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc a b, 2 * L ≤ progressColor P i) →
      ((Finset.Icc a b).filter fun i ↦ progressColor P i = 2 * L).card ≤ 2 ^ a)
    (hface : ∀ a b L, a ≤ b → b < N → L < (d + 1) ^ 2 →
      (∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc a b, 2 * L + 1 ≤ progressColor P i) →
      ((Finset.Icc a b).filter fun i ↦ progressColor P i = 2 * L + 1).card ≤
        intervalCapacity d ε a) :
    N < stoppingBound d ε
proof:
:=
  length_lt_intervalCapacityBound _ _ N (progressColor P) (progressColor_lt P)
    (hasIntervalCapacity_of_event_bounds P hδ hδnonneg hcomplete hface)

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.polytope_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polytope_carrier (x : D.Node) :
    (D.polytope x).carrier =
      convexHull ℝ (IntCoord.real '' (D.support x : Set (IntCoord (D.rank x))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polytope, RationalPolytope.ofFinsetConvexHull_carrier, Finset.coe_image]

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.transition_mem
statement:
theorem transition_mem {x y : D.Node} (h : x ≤ y) {q : RealCoord (D.rank x)}
    (hq : q ∈ (D.polytope x).carrier) : (D.transition h).real q ∈ (D.polytope y).carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.polytope_carrier] at hq
  apply convexHull_min (t := (D.transition h).real ⁻¹' (D.polytope y).carrier)
    ?_ ((D.polytope y).convex.affine_preimage _) hq
  rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  change (D.transition h).real z.real ∈ (D.polytope y).carrier
  rw [(D.transition h).real_integer, D.polytope_carrier]
  exact subset_convexHull ℝ _ ⟨(D.transition h).integer z, D.transition_support h hz, rfl⟩

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chart_real_injective
statement: theorem chart_real_injective (x : D.Node) : Function.Injective (D.chart C x).real
proof:
:=
  IntegralAffineMap.ofIntAffineMap_real_injective _ (C x).injective

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.transition_affineSpan
statement:
theorem transition_affineSpan {x y : D.Node} (h : x ≤ y) :
    ∀ z ∈ D.support x, (D.transition h).toIntAffineMap z ∈
      affineSpan ℤ (D.support y : Set (IntCoord (D.rank y)))
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  exact subset_affineSpan ℤ _ (D.transition_support h hz)

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chart_comp_transition
statement:
theorem chart_comp_transition {x y : D.Node} (h : x ≤ y) :
    (D.chart C y).comp (D.chartedTransition C h) = (D.transition h).comp (D.chart C x)
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegralAffineMap.ext_integer
  funext q
  exact (C x).map_transition (C y) (D.transition h).toIntAffineMap
    (D.transition_affineSpan h) q

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chart_transition_real
statement:
theorem chart_transition_real {x y : D.Node} (h : x ≤ y) (q : RealCoord (C x).rank) :
    (D.chart C y).real ((D.chartedTransition C h).real q) =
      (D.transition h).real ((D.chart C x).real q)
proof:
:=
  AffineMap.congr_fun (congrArg IntegralAffineMap.real (D.chart_comp_transition C h)) q

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chart_transition_modp
statement:
theorem chart_transition_modp {x y : D.Node} (h : x ≤ y) (p : ℕ)
    (q : FpCoord p (C x).rank) :
    (D.chart C y).modp p ((D.chartedTransition C h).modp p q) =
      (D.transition h).modp p ((D.chart C x).modp p q)
proof:
:=
  AffineMap.congr_fun (congrArg (fun A ↦ A.modp p) (D.chart_comp_transition C h)) q

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chartedTransition_support
proof:
:= by
  apply (C y).mem_coordinateSupport.mpr
  change (C y).map ((C x).transition (C y) _ _ q) ∈ D.support y
  rw [(C x).map_transition]
  exact D.transition_support h ((C x).mem_coordinateSupport.mp hq)

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chartedTransition_refl
statement:
theorem chartedTransition_refl (x : D.Node) :
    D.chartedTransition C (le_refl x) = IntegralAffineMap.id (C x).rank
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegralAffineMap.ext_integer
  funext q
  apply (C x).injective
  change (C x).map ((C x).transition (C x) _ _ q) = (C x).map q
  rw [(C x).map_transition]
  change (D.transition (le_refl x)).integer ((C x).map q) = (C x).map q
  rw [D.transition_refl]
  rfl

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chartedTransition_trans
statement:
theorem chartedTransition_trans {x y z : D.Node} (hxy : x ≤ y) (hyz : y ≤ z) :
    D.chartedTransition C (hxy.trans hyz) =
      (D.chartedTransition C hyz).comp (D.chartedTransition C hxy)
proof:
:= by
  apply IntegralAffineMap.ext_integer
  funext q
  apply (C z).injective
  change (C z).map ((C x).transition (C z) _ _ q) =
    (C z).map ((C y).transition (C z) _ _ ((C x).transition (C y) _ _ q))
  rw [(C x).map_transition, (C y).map_transition, (C x).map_transition]
  exact congrFun (congrArg IntegralAffineMap.integer (D.transition_trans hxy hyz)) ((C x).map q)

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chartedSupport_affineIntSpans
statement:
theorem chartedSupport_affineIntSpans (x : D.Node) :
    FlagDecomposition.AffineIntSpans ((D.rechart C).support x)
proof:
:=
  (C x).coordinateSupport_affineIntSpans

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chart_image_polytope
statement:
theorem chart_image_polytope (x : D.Node) :
    (D.chart C x).real '' ((D.rechart C).polytope x).carrier = (D.polytope x).carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [(D.rechart C).polytope_carrier, D.polytope_carrier, AffineMap.image_convexHull]
  congr 1
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(C x).map z, (C x).mem_coordinateSupport.mp hz, ((D.chart C x).real_integer z).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨((C x).coordinates z).real,
      ⟨(C x).coordinates z, (C x).coordinates_mem_coordinateSupport hz, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [(D.chart C x).real_integer]
    change ((C x).map ((C x).coordinates z)).real = z.real
    rw [(C x).map_coordinates_of_mem hz]

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.chart_mem_polytope_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chart_mem_polytope_iff (x : D.Node) (q : RealCoord (C x).rank) :
    (D.chart C x).real q ∈ (D.polytope x).carrier ↔ q ∈ ((D.rechart C).polytope x).carrier
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.chart_image_polytope C x]
  exact (D.chart_real_injective C x).mem_set_image

name: EGZ.LatticeSupportDiagram.charted_polytope_bound
statement:
theorem charted_polytope_bound {K B : D.Node → ℕ}
    (hD : ∀ x (z : IntCoord (D.rank x)),
      z.real ∈ (D.polytope x).carrier → latticeSupNorm z ≤ K x)
    (hC : ∀ x (q : IntCoord (C x).rank),
      latticeSupNorm ((C x).map q) ≤ K x → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B x) :
    ∀ x (q : IntCoord (C x).rank),
      q.real ∈ ((D.rechart C).polytope x).carrier → latticeSupNorm q ≤ B x
proof:
:= by
  intro x q hq
  apply hC
  apply hD
  change ((D.chart C x).integer q).real ∈ (D.polytope x).carrier
  rw [← (D.chart C x).real_integer]
  exact (D.chart_mem_polytope_iff C x q.real).mpr hq
